<script>
const D=window.D,L=window.L;
const SHIPS=D.SHIPS,SHIPS_ORDER=Object.keys(SHIPS);
const PORTS=D.PORTS,RESOURCES=D.RESOURCES;
const MISSION_GOLD=D.MISSION_GOLD_RANGES,MISSION_ENEMY=D.MISSION_ENEMY_RANGES;
const TRADE_MARGINS=D.TRADE_MISSION_PROFIT_MARGINS,SMUGGLE_MARGINS=D.SMUGGLE_PROFIT_MARGINS;
const STARTS=D.STARTS,TRADE_GOODS=D.TRADE_GOODS_BY_TIER,SMUGGLE_GOODS=D.SMUGGLE_GOODS_BY_TIER;
let SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT={low:0.70,medium:0.80,high:0.90};
if(D.SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT_CHANCE)SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT=D.SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT_CHANCE;
function getFameTier(f){if(f>=350)return 4;if(f>=200)return 3;if(f>=100)return 2;if(f>=50)return 1;return 0;}
function estCC(gbt,q){const c={};for(const[t,g]of Object.entries(gbt)){const ti=parseInt(t),vg=g.filter(x=>RESOURCES[x]);c[ti]=Math.round(vg.reduce((s,x)=>s+RESOURCES[x].basePrice,0)/Math.max(1,vg.length)*(q[ti]||5));}return c;}
const TRADE_COSTS=estCC(TRADE_GOODS,{0:3,1:8,2:12,3:20,4:25});
const SMUGGLE_COSTS=estCC(SMUGGLE_GOODS,{0:2,1:5,2:8,3:15,4:20});
const ds=STARTS.find(s=>s.id!=='debug')||STARTS[0];
const START_GOLD=ds.gold,START_CREW=ds.crewCount;

// STRICT SEQUENTIAL UPGRADE PATH - every strategy follows this exact order
const UPGRADE_SEQ=["dinghy","cutter","sloop (F20)","schooner (F50)","brigantine (F50)","corvette (F100)","frigate(F100)","galleon (F150)","ship_of_the_line (F150)"].filter(s=>SHIPS[s]);

// PORT DISTANCE MODEL
const pArr=Array.isArray(PORTS)?PORTS:Object.values(PORTS);
const portList=pArr.filter(p=>!p.hidden).map(p=>({n:p.name||p.id,x:p.mapX??p.x??0,y:p.mapY??p.y??0}));
if(portList.length<2){for(let i=portList.length;i<5;i++)portList.push({n:"P"+i,x:Math.random()*800,y:Math.random()*600});}
function pDist(a,b){const pa=portList[a%portList.length],pb=portList[b%portList.length];return Math.sqrt((pa.x-pb.x)**2+(pa.y-pb.y)**2);}
const _ad=[];for(let i=0;i<portList.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<portList.length;j++)_ad.push(pDist(i,j));
_ad.sort((a,b)=>a-b);const _md=_ad[Math.floor(_ad.length/2)]||100;
const DSCALE=_md>0?3.5/_md:0.01;
function calcTravel(dist,speed,cargoR){return Math.max(1,Math.round(dist*DSCALE*(10/Math.max(1,speed))*(cargoR>0.5?1+(cargoR-0.5)*0.6:1)));}
function pickPort(ci){let p;do{p=Math.floor(Math.random()*portList.length);}while(p===ci&&portList.length>1);return p;}

// STRATEGIES (upgrade path ignored - all use UPGRADE_SEQ now)
const STRATEGIES={
  "Low Risk":{tw:{escort:3,patrol:3,combat:2,trade:2,smuggle:0},rp:{low:8,medium:2,high:0},c:"#4caf50"},
  "High Risk":{tw:{escort:1,patrol:2,combat:3,trade:1,smuggle:1},rp:{low:0,medium:2,high:8},c:"#f44336"},
  "Combat Focus":{tw:{escort:1,patrol:3,combat:5,trade:0,smuggle:0},rp:{low:2,medium:4,high:4},c:"#ff9800"},
  "Trade Focus":{tw:{escort:1,patrol:0,combat:0,trade:8,smuggle:0},rp:{low:4,medium:5,high:1},c:"#2196f3"},
  "Smuggle Focus":{tw:{escort:2,patrol:2,combat:2,trade:2,smuggle:3},rp:{low:2,medium:4,high:4},c:"#9c27b0"},
  "Mixed":{tw:{escort:2,patrol:2,combat:2,trade:2,smuggle:1},rp:{low:3,medium:4,high:3},c:"#ffd700"},
  "Opportunistic":{tw:{},rp:{},c:"#00bcd4",ctx:true},
};

function pickOpportunistic(gold,fame,ship,crew,mor,tier,mTypes){
  const si=SHIPS_ORDER.indexOf(ship),s=SHIPS[ship],crewR=crew/Math.max(1,s.maxCrew);
  const weak=si<=1||crewR<0.3||crew<4,strong=si>=3&&crewR>=0.5&&crew>=10;
  const canT=gold>=(TRADE_COSTS[tier]||200),canS=gold>=(SMUGGLE_COSTS[tier]||100);
  let nc=Infinity;const uIdx=UPGRADE_SEQ.indexOf(ship);
  if(uIdx>=0&&uIdx<UPGRADE_SEQ.length-1){const ns=SHIPS[UPGRADE_SEQ[uIdx+1]];if(ns)nc=ns.cost;}
  const saving=gold<nc*0.8&&nc<Infinity;
  let mr;if(weak||mor<35)mr="low";else if(strong&&mor>60)mr=Math.random()<0.35?"high":"medium";else mr=Math.random()<0.25?"low":"medium";
  let mt;const r=Math.random();
  if(weak||mor<30){mt=canT?"trade":(r<0.5?"escort":"patrol");}
  else if(saving){if(r<0.45&&canT)mt="trade";else if(r<0.60&&canS)mt="smuggle";else mt=r<0.84?"combat":"escort";}
  else if(strong){if(r<0.40)mt="combat";else if(r<0.60)mt="patrol";else if(r<0.75&&canT)mt="trade";else if(r<0.85&&canS)mt="smuggle";else mt="escort";}
  else{if(r<0.25&&canT)mt="trade";else if(r<0.45)mt="combat";else if(r<0.65)mt="patrol";else if(r<0.80)mt="escort";else if(canS)mt="smuggle";else mt="patrol";}
  return[mt,mr];
}
function wc(opts,wts){const t=wts.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);if(t===0)return opts[Math.floor(Math.random()*opts.length)];let r=Math.random()*t,c=0;for(let i=0;i<opts.length;i++){c+=wts[i];if(r<=c)return opts[i];}return opts[opts.length-1];}


function simulate(sno,targetFame,maxDays){
  const S=typeof sno==="string"?STRATEGIES[sno]:sno;
  const isCtx=S.ctx||false;
  let gold=START_GOLD,fame=0,ship="dinghy",crew=START_CREW;
  let day=0,mdone=0,mor=70,food=8,water=8,infamy=0,heat=0;
  const snaps={},sms={};let lf=-1,st="port",sdl=0,cm=null;
  let softlockDay=null,dangerCount=0,minGold=START_GOLD,minMorale=70,minCrew=START_CREW;
  const pac={quiet:0,event:0,resolution:0,portArr:0,totalSail:0,mTypes:{escort:0,patrol:0,combat:0,trade:0,smuggle:0},cWins:0,cLoss:0};
  let curPort=Math.floor(Math.random()*portList.length),destPort=0;

  while(day<maxDays&&fame<targetFame){
    const tier=getFameTier(fame),s=SHIPS[ship];
    if(fame!==lf){const da=pac.totalSail>0?Math.round(100*pac.quiet/pac.totalSail):0;snaps[fame]={day,gold,ship,missions:mdone,crew,infamy,morale:mor,deadAir:da};lf=fame;}
    if(st==="port"){
      heat=Math.max(0,heat-2);
      minGold=Math.min(minGold,gold);minMorale=Math.min(minMorale,mor);minCrew=Math.min(minCrew,crew);
      if(gold<20&&food<=0&&water<=0&&crew<=1&&softlockDay===null)softlockDay=day;
      if(gold<50&&(food<=0||water<=0)&&crew<=3&&mor<30)dangerCount++;
      // Hire crew
      const si=SHIPS_ORDER.indexOf(ship);
      const tc=si<=0?Math.min(2,s.maxCrew):si<=1?Math.max(3,Math.floor(s.maxCrew*0.5)):Math.max(5,Math.floor(s.maxCrew*0.7));
      let bud=Math.max(0,gold-40);while(crew<tc&&bud>=50){crew++;gold-=50;bud-=50;}
      // Provisions
      const fpd=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(crew/10)),td=Math.max(3,Math.min(5,s.maxDays||8))+1;
      const needF=td*fpd-food;if(needF>0&&gold>=needF*3){food+=needF;gold-=needF*3;}
      const needW=td*fpd-water;if(needW>0&&gold>=needW*2){water+=needW;gold-=needW*2;}
      // STRICT SEQUENTIAL UPGRADE: buy the NEXT ship in UPGRADE_SEQ only
      const uIdx=UPGRADE_SEQ.indexOf(ship);
      if(uIdx>=0&&uIdx<UPGRADE_SEQ.length-1){
        const nextShipKey=UPGRADE_SEQ[uIdx+1];
        const ns=SHIPS[nextShipKey];
        if(ns&&fame>=(ns.requiredFame||0)&&gold>=ns.cost){
          gold-=ns.cost;ship=nextShipKey;
          sms[ship]={day,fame};
          const s2=SHIPS[ship],si2=SHIPS_ORDER.indexOf(ship);
          const tc2=si2<=1?Math.max(3,Math.floor(s2.maxCrew*0.5)):Math.max(5,Math.floor(s2.maxCrew*0.7));
          while(crew<tc2&&gold>=50){crew++;gold-=50;}
        }
      }
      // Mission selection
      let mt,mr;
      if(isCtx){[mt,mr]=pickOpportunistic(gold,fame,ship,crew,mor,tier,pac.mTypes);}
      else{for(let a=0;a<5;a++){mt=wc(Object.keys(S.tw),Object.values(S.tw));mr=wc(["low","medium","high"],["low","medium","high"].map(r=>S.rp[r]||1));if(mt==="trade"&&gold<(TRADE_COSTS[tier]||200))continue;if(mt==="smuggle"&&gold<(SMUGGLE_COSTS[tier]||100))continue;break;}}
      pac.mTypes[mt]=(pac.mTypes[mt]||0)+1;
      // Realistic travel
      destPort=pickPort(curPort);
      const dist=pDist(curPort,destPort);
      const cargoR=(mt==="trade"||mt==="smuggle")?0.7:0.2;
      const spd=SHIPS[ship].speed||10;
      const tdl=calcTravel(dist,spd,cargoR);
      cm={type:mt,risk:mr,travel:tdl,tier};sdl=tdl;st="sailing";mor=Math.min(100,mor+3);
    }else{
      const wm=mor<30?1.5:1.0;gold=Math.max(0,gold-Math.floor(crew*2*wm));
      const fc=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(crew/10));food=Math.max(0,food-fc);water=Math.max(0,water-fc);
      if(food<=0||water<=0)mor=Math.max(0,mor-3);
      // Heat-based encounter
      const mtype=cm?cm.type:"";
      const encChance=Math.min(0.30,0.05+heat*0.015+infamy*0.003+(mtype==="smuggle"?0.03:0)+(["patrol","escort"].includes(mtype)?0.02:0));
      let hadEvent=false;
      if(st==="sailing"&&Math.random()<encChance){
        hadEvent=true;const ev=Math.random();
        if(ev<0.15){sdl++;mor=Math.max(0,mor-3);}
        else if(ev<0.25){sdl++;}
        else if(ev<0.40){gold+=30+Math.floor(Math.random()*170);}
        else if(ev<0.55){crew=Math.max(1,crew-Math.floor(Math.random()*2));}
        else{const si2=SHIPS_ORDER.indexOf(ship);if(si2>=2&&Math.random()<0.6){gold+=20+Math.floor(Math.random()*80);fame+=1;heat+=1;}else{mor=Math.max(0,mor-4);heat+=0.5;}}
      }
      sdl--;day++;pac.totalSail++;
      if(sdl<=0){
        if(st==="sailing"){
          pac.resolution++;
          const{tier:t,risk,type:mtp}=cm;
          const gr=MISSION_GOLD[t]?.[risk]||MISSION_GOLD[0].low;
          const mgold=gr[0]+Math.floor(Math.random()*(gr[1]-gr[0]+1));
          const mfame=t===0?1:(risk==="high"?3:risk==="medium"?2:1);
          const s=SHIPS[ship],si=SHIPS_ORDER.indexOf(ship);
          if(["escort","patrol","combat"].includes(mtp)){
            const ecR=MISSION_ENEMY.cannons[t]||[2,6],ecrR=MISSION_ENEMY.crew[t]||[8,18];
            const ec=ecR[0]+Math.floor(Math.random()*(ecR[1]-ecR[0]+1)),ecr=ecrR[0]+Math.floor(Math.random()*(ecrR[1]-ecrR[0]+1));
            if(si<=0){if(Math.random()<0.80){gold+=Math.floor(mgold*0.4);fame+=mfame;mdone++;pac.cWins++;heat+=2;}else{crew=Math.max(1,crew-Math.floor(Math.random()*2));mor=Math.max(0,mor-5);gold+=Math.floor(mgold*0.15);fame+=Math.max(0,mfame-1);mdone++;pac.cLoss++;heat+=1;}}
            else if(si<=1){if(Math.random()<0.70){gold+=Math.floor(mgold*0.5);fame+=mfame;mdone++;pac.cWins++;heat+=2;}else{const pr=(s.cannons*Math.max(1,crew))/Math.max(1,ec*ecr),rm=risk==="low"?0.15:risk==="high"?-0.15:0,wp=Math.min(0.95,Math.max(0.20,0.5+(pr-1)*0.3+rm));if(Math.random()<wp){gold+=mgold+Math.floor(mgold*0.25);fame+=mfame;mdone++;mor=Math.min(100,mor+5);pac.cWins++;heat+=3;}else{crew=Math.max(1,crew-1-Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.max(1,Math.floor(crew/6))));mor=Math.max(0,mor-12);gold=Math.max(0,gold-Math.floor(gold*0.10));pac.cLoss++;heat+=1;}}}
            else{const pr=(s.cannons*Math.max(1,crew))/Math.max(1,ec*ecr),rm=risk==="low"?0.15:risk==="high"?-0.15:0,wp=Math.min(0.95,Math.max(0.20,0.5+(pr-1)*0.3+rm));if(Math.random()<wp){gold+=mgold+Math.floor(mgold*0.25);fame+=mfame;mdone++;mor=Math.min(100,mor+5);crew=Math.max(1,crew-Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.max(1,Math.floor(crew/12))));pac.cWins++;heat+=3;}else{crew=Math.max(1,crew-1-Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.max(1,Math.floor(crew/6))));mor=Math.max(0,mor-12);gold=Math.max(0,gold-Math.floor(gold*0.10));pac.cLoss++;heat+=1;}}
          }else if(mtp==="trade"){const cc=TRADE_COSTS[t]||200,mg=TRADE_MARGINS[risk]||0.8;if(gold>=cc){gold=gold+Math.floor(cc*mg)+mgold;fame+=mfame;mdone++;}}
          else if(mtp==="smuggle"){
            const cc=SMUGGLE_COSTS[t]||100,mg=SMUGGLE_MARGINS[risk]||1.0,ic=SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT[risk]||0.4;
            if(gold>=cc){gold-=cc;
              if(Math.random()<ic){heat+=2;const fleeChance=si<=0?0.80:si<=1?0.75:0.60;
                if(Math.random()<fleeChance){gold+=cc+Math.floor(cc*mg)+mgold;fame+=mfame;mdone++;infamy+=2;mor=Math.max(0,mor-5);}
                else{const ecR=MISSION_ENEMY.cannons[t]||[2,6],ecrR=MISSION_ENEMY.crew[t]||[8,18],ec2=ecR[0]+Math.floor(Math.random()*(ecR[1]-ecR[0]+1)),ecr2=ecrR[0]+Math.floor(Math.random()*(ecrR[1]-ecrR[0]+1)),pr2=(s.cannons*Math.max(1,crew))/Math.max(1,ec2*ecr2),wp2=Math.min(0.90,Math.max(0.15,0.5+(pr2-1)*0.3));
                  if(Math.random()<wp2){gold+=cc+Math.floor(cc*mg)+mgold;fame+=mfame;mdone++;infamy+=3;mor=Math.max(0,mor-8);crew=Math.max(1,crew-Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.max(1,Math.floor(crew/8))));heat+=3;}
                  else{gold=Math.max(0,gold-Math.floor(cc*0.3));infamy+=2;mor=Math.max(0,mor-15);crew=Math.max(1,crew-1-Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.max(1,Math.floor(crew/5))));heat+=1;}}
              }else{gold+=cc+Math.floor(cc*mg)+mgold;fame+=mfame;mdone++;infamy+=1;}}
          }
          sdl=cm.travel;st="returning";
        }else{pac.portArr++;mor=Math.min(100,mor+5);curPort=destPort;st="port";}
      }else{if(hadEvent)pac.event++;else pac.quiet++;}
    }
  }
  const da=pac.totalSail>0?Math.round(100*pac.quiet/pac.totalSail):0;
  snaps[fame]={day,gold,ship,missions:mdone,crew,infamy,morale:mor,deadAir:da};
  return{snaps,sms,final_fame:fame,final_day:day,final_ship:ship,missions_done:mdone,reached:fame>=targetFame,infamy,softlockDay,dangerCount,minGold,minMorale,minCrew,pacing:pac};
}


function atFame(runs,fl,field){return runs.map(r=>{const best=Object.keys(r.snaps).map(Number).filter(f=>f<=fl).sort((a,b)=>b-a)[0];return best!==undefined?r.snaps[best][field]:null;}).filter(v=>v!==null);}
function median(arr){if(!arr.length)return 0;const s=[...arr].sort((a,b)=>a-b);const m=Math.floor(s.length/2);return s.length%2?s[m]:(s[m-1]+s[m])/2;}
function pct(arr,p){if(!arr.length)return 0;const s=[...arr].sort((a,b)=>a-b);const i=(p/100)*(s.length-1);const lo=Math.floor(i),hi=Math.ceil(i);return s[lo]+(s[hi]-s[lo])*(i-lo);}
function mode(arr){const c={};arr.forEach(v=>{c[v]=(c[v]||0)+1;});return Object.entries(c).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]?.[0]||"?";}

function drawLineChart(cid,allRes,field,tf,logS){
  const cv=document.getElementById(cid),cx=cv.getContext("2d"),W=cv.width,H=cv.height;
  const pad={l:60,r:20,t:20,b:30},pw=W-pad.l-pad.r,ph=H-pad.t-pad.b;
  cx.fillStyle="#0d1620";cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  let yMn=Infinity,yMx=-Infinity;const sd={};
  for(const[n,runs]of Object.entries(allRes)){const ms=[];for(let f=0;f<=tf;f++){const v=atFame(runs,f,field);const m=v.length?median(v):(ms.length?ms[ms.length-1]:0);ms.push(logS?Math.max(1,m):m);}sd[n]=ms;ms.forEach(v=>{if(v<yMn)yMn=v;if(v>yMx)yMx=v;});}
  if(logS){yMn=1;yMx=Math.max(yMx,10);}else{yMn=0;}
  const toX=f=>pad.l+(f/tf)*pw;
  const toY=v=>{if(logS)return pad.t+ph-(Math.log10(Math.max(1,v))-Math.log10(yMn))/(Math.log10(yMx)-Math.log10(yMn))*ph;return pad.t+ph-((v-yMn)/Math.max(1,yMx-yMn))*ph;};
  cx.strokeStyle="#1a2a3a";cx.lineWidth=0.5;[20,50,100].forEach(f=>{const x=toX(f);cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(x,pad.t);cx.lineTo(x,pad.t+ph);cx.stroke();});
  cx.fillStyle="#606060";cx.font="9px monospace";cx.textAlign="center";for(let f=0;f<=tf;f+=50)cx.fillText(f,toX(f),H-4);
  cx.textAlign="right";
  if(logS){for(let p=0;p<=Math.ceil(Math.log10(yMx));p++){const v=Math.pow(10,p);if(v>=yMn&&v<=yMx)cx.fillText(v>=1000?(v/1000)+"k":v,pad.l-4,toY(v)+3);}}
  else{const step=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.max(1,yMx))))/2||1;for(let v=0;v<=yMx;v+=step)cx.fillText(v>=1000?Math.round(v/1000)+"k":Math.round(v),pad.l-4,toY(v)+3);}
  for(const[n,info]of Object.entries(STRATEGIES)){const ms=sd[n];if(!ms)continue;cx.strokeStyle=info.c;cx.lineWidth=1.8;cx.globalAlpha=0.9;cx.beginPath();for(let f=0;f<=tf;f++){const x=toX(f),y=toY(ms[f]);f===0?cx.moveTo(x,y):cx.lineTo(x,y);}cx.stroke();cx.globalAlpha=1;}
  let ly=pad.t+10;cx.font="9px monospace";for(const[n,info]of Object.entries(STRATEGIES)){cx.fillStyle=info.c;cx.fillRect(pad.l+8,ly-4,12,3);cx.fillStyle="#a0a0a0";cx.textAlign="left";cx.fillText(n,pad.l+24,ly);ly+=12;}
}

function drawBarChart(cid,allRes,tf){
  const cv=document.getElementById(cid),cx=cv.getContext("2d"),W=cv.width,H=cv.height;
  const pad={l:50,r:20,t:20,b:40},pw=W-pad.l-pad.r,ph=H-pad.t-pad.b;
  cx.fillStyle="#0d1620";cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const ships=UPGRADE_SEQ.filter(s=>s!=="dinghy"),nS=Object.keys(STRATEGIES).length,gW=pw/ships.length,bW=gW/(nS+1);
  cx.textAlign="center";cx.font="8px monospace";cx.fillStyle="#a0a0a0";ships.forEach((s,i)=>{cx.fillText(s.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+s.slice(1),pad.l+gW*i+gW/2,H-8);});
  const toY=v=>pad.t+ph-(v/tf)*ph;
  cx.strokeStyle="#1a2a3a";cx.lineWidth=0.5;[50,100,150,200].forEach(v=>{const y=toY(v);cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(pad.l,y);cx.lineTo(pad.l+pw,y);cx.stroke();});
  cx.textAlign="right";cx.fillStyle="#606060";[0,50,100,150,200].forEach(v=>{cx.fillText("F"+v,pad.l-4,toY(v)+3);});
  let si=0;for(const[n,info]of Object.entries(STRATEGIES)){const runs=allRes[n];ships.forEach((ms,i)=>{const fms=runs.filter(r=>r.sms[ms]).map(r=>r.sms[ms].fame);const val=fms.length>=runs.length*0.25?median(fms):tf+10;const x=pad.l+gW*i+bW*(si+0.5),y=toY(Math.min(val,tf)),h=pad.t+ph-y;cx.fillStyle=info.c;cx.globalAlpha=val<=tf?0.8:0.15;cx.fillRect(x,y,bW*0.8,h);cx.globalAlpha=1;if(val<=tf){cx.fillStyle=info.c;cx.font="7px monospace";cx.textAlign="center";cx.fillText("F"+Math.round(val),x+bW*0.4,y-3);}});si++;}
}


async function runSimulation(){
  const btn=document.getElementById("runBtn");btn.disabled=true;
  const fill=document.getElementById("progressFill"),status=document.getElementById("status");
  const targetFame=parseInt(document.getElementById("targetFame").value)||200;
  const nRuns=parseInt(document.getElementById("nRuns").value)||100;
  const maxDays=parseInt(document.getElementById("maxDays").value)||2000;

  const lv=document.getElementById("loaded-values");
  let vh=`<b>Start:</b> ${START_GOLD}g, ${START_CREW} crew<br><b>Ships:</b> `;
  for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(SHIPS))vh+=`${k}(${v.cost}g/F${v.requiredFame||0}) `;
  vh+=`<br><b>Upgrade path:</b> ${UPGRADE_SEQ.join(" \u2192 ")}`;
  vh+=`<br><b>Ports:</b> ${portList.length} (med dist=${Math.round(_md)}px, scale=${DSCALE.toFixed(4)})`;
  vh+=`<br><b>Smuggle intercept:</b> ${JSON.stringify(SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT)}`;
  lv.innerHTML=vh;

  const swSteps=17,swRuns=Math.max(30,Math.floor(nRuns/2));
  const allRes={},strats=Object.keys(STRATEGIES);
  let done=0,total=strats.length*nRuns+swSteps*swRuns;

  for(const name of strats){const runs=[];for(let i=0;i<nRuns;i++){runs.push(simulate(name,targetFame,maxDays));done++;if(done%10===0){fill.style.width=(done/total*100)+"%";status.textContent=`${name}: ${i+1}/${nRuns} (${Math.round(done/total*100)}%)`;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));}}allRes[name]=runs;status.textContent=`Done: ${name}`;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));}

  // SMUGGLE SWEEP
  status.textContent="Smuggle sweep...";await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
  const swRes=[];
  for(let pS=10;pS<=90;pS+=5){
    const sw=Math.round(pS/5),rest=Math.round((100-pS)/5),each=Math.max(1,Math.floor(rest/4));
    const tmp={tw:{escort:each,patrol:each,combat:each,trade:each,smuggle:sw},rp:{low:2,medium:5,high:3}};
    const runs=[];for(let i=0;i<swRuns;i++){runs.push(simulate(tmp,targetFame,maxDays));done++;if(done%10===0){fill.style.width=(done/total*100)+"%";status.textContent=`Sweep ${pS}%: ${i+1}/${swRuns}`;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));}}
    const reached=runs.filter(r=>r.reached).length,sl=runs.filter(r=>r.softlockDay!==null).length;
    swRes.push({pS,rr:Math.round(reached/swRuns*100),sr:Math.round(sl/swRuns*100),
      md:reached>0?Math.round(median(runs.filter(r=>r.reached).map(r=>r.final_day))):null,
      mg:Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>r.snaps[r.final_fame]?.gold||0))),
      ad:(runs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.dangerCount,0)/swRuns).toFixed(1),
      mm:Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>r.final_day>0?r.missions_done/r.final_day*100:0))*10)/10,
      mi:Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>r.infamy)))});
  }

  fill.style.width="100%";status.textContent="Rendering...";
  document.getElementById("results").style.display="block";

  // ═══ COMPARISON TABLE ═══
  const mils=[20,50,100,Math.min(targetFame,150),targetFame];
  let th=`<table><tr><th>Strategy</th>`;mils.forEach(fm=>th+=`<th colspan="4" style="text-align:center">F${fm}</th>`);th+=`<th>OK?</th></tr><tr><th></th>`;mils.forEach(()=>th+=`<th>Day</th><th>Gold</th><th>Miss</th><th>Ship</th>`);th+=`<th></th></tr>`;
  for(const[n,info]of Object.entries(STRATEGIES)){const runs=allRes[n],rc=runs.filter(r=>r.reached).length;th+=`<tr><td style="color:${info.c};font-weight:bold">${n}</td>`;mils.forEach(fm=>{const d=atFame(runs,fm,"day"),g=atFame(runs,fm,"gold"),m=atFame(runs,fm,"missions"),sh=atFame(runs,fm,"ship");if(runs.filter(r=>r.final_fame>=fm).length>0){const sn=mode(sh);th+=`<td class="val">${Math.round(median(d))}</td><td class="val">${Math.round(median(g)).toLocaleString()}</td><td class="val">${Math.round(median(m))}</td><td class="dim">${sn.length>8?sn.slice(0,7)+"..":sn}</td>`;}else th+=`<td class="dim" colspan="4">stalled</td>`;});th+=`<td style="color:${rc>=nRuns*0.8?'#4caf50':rc>=nRuns*0.4?'#ff9800':'#f44336'}">${rc}/${nRuns}</td></tr>`;}
  th+=`</table>`;document.getElementById("compTable").innerHTML=th;

  // ═══ SHIP MILESTONES (strict sequential, day+fame ranges) ═══
  const msShips=UPGRADE_SEQ.filter(s=>s!=="dinghy");
  let sm=`<p class="dim">All strategies follow strict upgrade path: ${UPGRADE_SEQ.join(" \u2192 ")}. Shows when each ship becomes affordable and is purchased.</p>`;
  sm+=`<table><tr><th rowspan="2">Strategy</th>`;msShips.forEach(s=>{const cap=s.replace(/_/g,' ').replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase());sm+=`<th colspan="3" style="text-align:center">${cap}</th>`;});
  sm+=`</tr><tr>`;msShips.forEach(()=>sm+=`<th>Day<br><span class="rng">p10-p90</span></th><th>Fame<br><span class="rng">p10-p90</span></th><th>%</th>`);sm+=`</tr>`;
  for(const[n,info]of Object.entries(STRATEGIES)){
    const runs=allRes[n];
    sm+=`<tr><td style="color:${info.c};font-weight:bold">${n}</td>`;
    msShips.forEach(s=>{
      const got=runs.filter(r=>r.sms[s]);const pctR=Math.round(got.length/nRuns*100);
      if(got.length>=3){
        const days=got.map(r=>r.sms[s].day),fames=got.map(r=>r.sms[s].fame);
        const medD=Math.round(median(days)),p10D=Math.round(pct(days,10)),p90D=Math.round(pct(days,90));
        const medF=Math.round(median(fames)),p10F=Math.round(pct(fames,10)),p90F=Math.round(pct(fames,90));
        const col=pctR>=75?'#4caf50':pctR>=50?'#ff9800':'#f44336';
        sm+=`<td class="val">${medD}<br><span class="rng">${p10D}-${p90D}</span></td>`;
        sm+=`<td class="val">F${medF}<br><span class="rng">F${p10F}-F${p90F}</span></td>`;
        sm+=`<td class="val" style="color:${col}">${pctR}%</td>`;
      }else{sm+=`<td class="dim" colspan="3">${pctR>0?pctR+'%':'---'}</td>`;}
    });
    sm+=`</tr>`;
  }
  sm+=`</table>`;
  document.getElementById("shipMilestones").innerHTML=sm;

  // ═══ SOFTLOCK TABLE ═══
  let sl=`<table><tr><th>Strategy</th><th>Softlock</th><th>Med Day</th><th>Danger/Run</th><th>p10 Gold</th><th>p10 Morale</th><th>p10 Crew</th></tr>`;
  for(const[n,info]of Object.entries(STRATEGIES)){const runs=allRes[n],slr=runs.filter(r=>r.softlockDay!==null),sr=Math.round(slr.length/nRuns*100),sd=slr.length>0?Math.round(median(slr.map(r=>r.softlockDay))):"--",ad=(runs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.dangerCount,0)/nRuns).toFixed(1),pg=Math.round(pct(runs.map(r=>r.minGold),10)),pm=Math.round(pct(runs.map(r=>r.minMorale),10)),pc=Math.round(pct(runs.map(r=>r.minCrew),10)),sc=sr===0?'#4caf50':sr<10?'#ff9800':'#f44336';
  sl+=`<tr><td style="color:${info.c};font-weight:bold">${n}</td><td class="val" style="color:${sc}">${sr}%</td><td class="val">${sd}</td><td class="val">${ad}</td><td class="val ${pg<50?'red':''}">${pg}</td><td class="val ${pm<20?'red':pm<35?'gold':''}">${pm}</td><td class="val ${pc<3?'red':''}">${pc}</td></tr>`;}
  sl+=`</table><div class="dim">Softlock=gold&lt;20+food=0+water=0+crew&le;1. p10=worst 10%.</div>`;document.getElementById("softlockTable").innerHTML=sl;

  // ═══ ENGAGEMENT TABLE ═══
  let eh=`<h3>Summary</h3><table><tr><th>Strategy</th><th>Dead Air %</th><th>Evt/100d</th><th>Miss/100d</th><th>Avg Cycle</th><th>E%</th><th>P%</th><th>C%</th><th>T%</th><th>S%</th></tr>`;
  for(const[n,info]of Object.entries(STRATEGIES)){const runs=allRes[n],mda=Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>r.pacing.totalSail>0?100*r.pacing.quiet/r.pacing.totalSail:0))),mev=Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>r.final_day>0?r.pacing.event/r.final_day*100:0))*10)/10,mmi=Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>r.final_day>0?r.missions_done/r.final_day*100:0))*10)/10,ac=Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>r.missions_done>0?r.final_day/r.missions_done:999)));
  const totM=r=>{const p=r.pacing.mTypes;return(p.escort||0)+(p.patrol||0)+(p.combat||0)+(p.trade||0)+(p.smuggle||0);},mp=(r,k)=>{const t=totM(r);return t>0?(r.pacing.mTypes[k]||0)/t*100:0;};
  eh+=`<tr><td style="color:${info.c};font-weight:bold">${n}</td><td class="val ${mda>70?'red':mda>50?'gold':''}">${mda}%</td><td class="val">${mev}</td><td class="val">${mmi}</td><td class="val">${ac}</td><td class="val dim">${Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>mp(r,"escort"))))}</td><td class="val dim">${Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>mp(r,"patrol"))))}</td><td class="val dim">${Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>mp(r,"combat"))))}</td><td class="val dim">${Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>mp(r,"trade"))))}</td><td class="val dim">${Math.round(median(runs.map(r=>mp(r,"smuggle"))))}</td></tr>`;}
  eh+=`</table>`;
  const oR=allRes["Opportunistic"],ph2=[[0,20,"Dinghy"],[20,50,"Cutter"],[50,100,"Sloop"],[100,targetFame,"Brig+"]];
  eh+=`<h3>Opportunistic Phases</h3><table><tr><th>Phase</th><th>Fame</th><th>Days</th><th>Miss</th><th>D/M</th><th>Dead Air</th><th>Gold Start</th><th>Gold End</th></tr>`;
  ph2.forEach(([f0,f1,lb])=>{const d0=atFame(oR,f0,"day"),d1=atFame(oR,f1,"day"),m0=atFame(oR,f0,"missions"),m1=atFame(oR,f1,"missions"),g0=atFame(oR,f0,"gold"),g1=atFame(oR,f1,"gold"),da1=atFame(oR,f1,"deadAir");if(d0.length&&d1.length){const dd=Math.round(median(d1)-median(d0)),dm=Math.round(median(m1)-median(m0)),daM=Math.round(median(da1));eh+=`<tr><td>${lb}</td><td class="val">${f0}-${f1}</td><td class="val">~${dd}</td><td class="val">~${dm}</td><td class="val">${(dd/Math.max(1,dm)).toFixed(1)}</td><td class="val ${daM>70?'red':daM>50?'gold':''}">${daM}%</td><td class="val gold">${Math.round(median(g0)).toLocaleString()}</td><td class="val gold">${Math.round(median(g1)).toLocaleString()}</td></tr>`;}});
  eh+=`</table><div class="dim">Heat encounter model: base 5% + heat*1.5% + infamy*0.3% + mission bonus. Heat decays -2/port visit.</div>`;
  document.getElementById("engagementTable").innerHTML=eh;

  // ═══ SMUGGLE SWEEP ═══
  let sw2=`<p class="dim">${swRuns} runs/ratio. Rest split equally among E/P/C/T.</p>`;
  sw2+=`<table><tr><th>Smug %</th><th>Reach</th><th>Softlock</th><th>Med Days</th><th>Med Gold</th><th>Danger</th><th>Miss/100d</th><th>Infamy</th></tr>`;
  let sweet=null;swRes.forEach(r=>{if(r.sr<10&&r.rr>70&&(sweet===null||r.pS>sweet))sweet=r.pS;});
  swRes.forEach(r=>{const rc=r.rr>80?'#4caf50':r.rr>50?'#ff9800':'#f44336',sc=r.sr===0?'#4caf50':r.sr<15?'#ff9800':'#f44336';
    sw2+=`<tr${r.pS===sweet?' class="sweet"':''}><td style="font-weight:bold">${r.pS}%</td><td class="val" style="color:${rc}">${r.rr}%</td><td class="val" style="color:${sc}">${r.sr}%</td>`;
    sw2+=`<td class="val">${r.md!==null?r.md:'--'}</td><td class="val">${r.mg.toLocaleString()}</td>`;
    sw2+=`<td class="val">${r.ad}</td><td class="val">${r.mm}</td><td class="val">${r.mi}</td></tr>`;});
  sw2+=`</table>`;
  if(sweet!==null)sw2+=`<p style="margin-top:8px;color:#4caf50;font-weight:bold">Sweet spot: ${sweet}% smuggle (highest with softlock&lt;10% &amp; reach&gt;70%)</p>`;
  else sw2+=`<p style="margin-top:8px;color:#f44336">No safe sweet spot found.</p>`;
  document.getElementById("smuggleSweep").innerHTML=sw2;

  // ═══ CHARTS ═══
  drawLineChart("chartGold",allRes,"gold",targetFame,true);
  drawLineChart("chartDays",allRes,"day",targetFame,false);
  drawLineChart("chartMissions",allRes,"missions",targetFame,false);
  drawBarChart("chartShips",allRes,targetFame);
  drawLineChart("chartDeadAir",allRes,"deadAir",targetFame,false);
  drawLineChart("chartMorale",allRes,"morale",targetFame,false);

  status.textContent=`Done. ${Object.keys(allRes).length} strats x ${nRuns} + sweep (${swSteps} x ${swRuns}).`;
  btn.disabled=false;
}

</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const D=window.D,L=window.L,G=window.G;
const FACTIONS_LIST=["english","spanish","french","dutch","pirate"];
const FACTION_LABELS={english:"English",spanish:"Spanish",french:"French",dutch:"Dutch",pirate:"Pirate"};
const PORTS_LIST=Object.keys(D.PORTS);
const SHIP_NAMES=D.ENEMY_SHIP_NAMES?[...D.ENEMY_SHIP_NAMES.adjectives.slice(0,8)].map((a,i)=>`The ${a} ${(D.ENEMY_SHIP_NAMES.nouns||["Ship"])[i%D.ENEMY_SHIP_NAMES.nouns.length]}`):["The Black Serpent","The Iron Drake"];
const GOODS=Object.keys(D.RESOURCES).filter(g=>g!=="food"&&g!=="water");

function switchTab(id){
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('tab-'+id).classList.add('active');
  event.target.classList.add('active');
}

function h2(t){return`<h2>${t}</h2>`;}
function h3(t){return`<h3>${t}</h3>`;}
function tbl(hd,rows){
  let h='<table><tr>'+hd.map(x=>`<th>${x}</th>`).join('')+'</tr>';
  rows.forEach(r=>{h+='<tr>'+r.map(c=>`<td>${c}</td>`).join('')+'</tr>';});
  return h+'</table>';
}
function pct(n,total){return total>0?`${(n/total*100).toFixed(1)}%`:'0%';}

// Normalize: replace names, numbers, ports, goods for pattern detection
function normalize(msg){
  let s=msg.replace(/\d+/g,'N');
  D.CREW_FIRST_NAMES&&Object.values(D.CREW_FIRST_NAMES).flat().forEach(n=>{s=s.split(n).join('NAME');});
  D.CREW_LAST_NAMES&&Object.values(D.CREW_LAST_NAMES).flat().forEach(n=>{s=s.split(n).join('NAME');});
  Object.values(D.PORTS).forEach(p=>{s=s.split(p.name).join('PORT');});
  Object.values(D.RESOURCES).forEach(r=>{if(r.name)s=s.split(r.name).join('GOOD');s=s.split(r.name?.toLowerCase()||'').join('good');});
  Object.values(D.FACTIONS).forEach(f=>{if(f.label)s=s.split(f.label).join('FACTION');});
  return s;
}

function classifyLog(msg){
  if(msg.startsWith("Arrived")||msg.startsWith("Dropped")||msg.startsWith("Made port")||msg.includes("comes into view"))return"arrival";
  if(msg.includes("Mission complete")||msg.includes("Completed:"))return"mission";
  if(msg.includes("Bought"))return"trade_buy";
  if(msg.includes("Sold"))return"trade_sell";
  if(msg.includes("Repaired"))return"repair";
  if(msg.includes("Game saved"))return"save";
  if(msg.includes("Victory")||msg.includes("defeated.")||msg.includes("strikes her")||msg.includes("sinks beneath"))return"combat_win";
  if(msg.includes("Defeated by")||msg.includes("overwhelmed")||msg.includes("battle is lost"))return"combat_loss";
  if(msg.includes("Lost crew:"))return"crew_death";
  if(msg.includes("left the crew")||msg.includes("deserted"))return"desertion";
  if(msg.includes("settled down")||msg.includes("calmed down")||msg.includes("Tensions"))return"crew_calmed";
  if(msg.includes("disturbed")||msg.includes("upset"))return"crew_upset";
  if(msg.includes("seasoned")||msg.includes("veteran")||msg.includes("sea legs")||msg.includes("loyal"))return"crew_milestone";
  if(msg.toLowerCase().includes("storm")||msg.toLowerCase().includes("squall"))return"event_storm";
  if(msg.includes("Becalmed")||msg.includes("sails hang"))return"event_calm";
  if(msg.toLowerCase().includes("wreck")||msg.includes("Salvaged"))return"event_wreck";
  if(msg.toLowerCase().includes("whale"))return"event_whale";
  if(msg.toLowerCase().includes("mutiny")||msg.includes("mutineer"))return"event_mutiny";
  if(msg.includes("Plundered"))return"plunder";
  if(msg.toLowerCase().includes("rum")&&(msg.includes("drinking")||msg.includes("helped")))return"trait_drunkard";
  if(msg.includes("shaking")||msg.includes("terrified"))return"trait_coward";
  if(msg.includes("demands")||msg.includes("larger share")||msg.includes("usual cut"))return"trait_greedy";
  if(msg.includes("brawl")||msg.includes("another fight"))return"trait_troublemaker";
  if(msg.includes("Rescued"))return"event_rescue";
  if(msg.includes("harbourmaster")||msg.includes("Warships"))return"heat_gossip";
  return"other";
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  BIO ANALYSIS
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function runBioAnalysis(){
  const count=parseInt(document.getElementById('bioCount').value)||200;
  const fill=document.getElementById('bioFill');
  const status=document.getElementById('statusA');
  const out=document.getElementById('bioResults');
  
  if(!G.generateCrewBio){out.innerHTML='<div class="bad">G.generateCrewBio not found. Is generators.js loaded?</div>';return;}
  
  status.textContent='Generating...';fill.style.width='0%';
  
  const ALL_TAGS=["scar_battle","scar_storm","scar_mutiny","scar_grapple","scar_shipwreck",
    "revealed_drunkard","revealed_coward","revealed_greedy","revealed_troublemaker",
    "mutineer","upset","seasoned","veteran","loyal"];
  const DAYS_POOL=[0,3,7,12,20,30,45,55,70,85,100,120,150,180,200,230,260,300];
  
  const bios=[];const members=[];
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const days=DAYS_POOL[Math.floor(Math.random()*DAYS_POOL.length)];
    const faction=FACTIONS_LIST[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)];
    const role=["deckhand","gunner","cook","carpenter","navigator"][Math.floor(Math.random()*5)];
    const tags=[];
    const scarChance=Math.min(0.5,days/400);
    ["scar_battle","scar_storm","scar_mutiny","scar_grapple","scar_shipwreck"].forEach(s=>{if(Math.random()<scarChance)tags.push(s);});
    ["revealed_drunkard","revealed_coward","revealed_greedy","revealed_troublemaker"].forEach(t=>{if(Math.random()<0.05)tags.push(t);});
    if(Math.random()<0.08)tags.push("mutineer");
    if(Math.random()<0.05)tags.push("upset");
    if(days>=50&&Math.random()<0.3&&!tags.includes("veteran"))tags.push("seasoned");
    if(days>=100&&Math.random()<0.3)tags.push("veteran");
    if(days>=200&&Math.random()<0.2)tags.push("loyal");
    
    const member={id:i,firstName:G.generateCrewMember?G.generateCrewMember(faction).firstName:"Crew"+i,
      lastName:G.generateCrewMember?G.generateCrewMember(faction).lastName:"Member",
      role,faction,daysAboard:days,tags};
    members.push(member);
    try{bios.push(G.generateCrewBio(member));}catch(e){bios.push("(error: "+e.message+")");}
    if(i%50===0){fill.style.width=(i/count*100)+"%";status.textContent=`Generated ${i}/${count}...`;}
  }
  fill.style.width='100%';status.textContent='Analyzing...';

  // Store bios globally for export
  window._lastBios = bios;

  // Analysis
  const uniqueBios=new Set(bios).size;
  const exactCounts={};bios.forEach(b=>{exactCounts[b]=(exactCounts[b]||0)+1;});
  const sorted=Object.entries(exactCounts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  
  // Sentence analysis
  const openings={};const scarSentences={};const traitSentences={};
  bios.forEach(bio=>{
    const first=bio.split('. ')[0]+'.';
    const norm=normalize(first);openings[norm]=(openings[norm]||0)+1;
    bio.split('. ').forEach(sent=>{
      const s=sent.trim();
      if(s.includes('survived')||s.includes('scars of')||s.includes('left its mark')||s.includes('nearly killed'))
        scarSentences[s]=(scarSentences[s]||0)+1;
      if(s.includes('drink')||s.includes('nerve')||s.includes('fights ashore')||s.includes('bigger cut')||
         s.includes('bottle')||s.includes('bravest')||s.includes('Trouble')||s.includes('coin'))
        traitSentences[s]=(traitSentences[s]||0)+1;
    });
  });
  
  // Bio length
  const lengths={};bios.forEach(b=>{const n=b.split('. ').length;lengths[n]=(lengths[n]||0)+1;});
  
  // Render
  let html='';
  html+=h2(`🧑 Bio Analysis — ${count} crew generated`);
  html+=`<div class="${uniqueBios/count>0.85?'good':uniqueBios/count>0.7?'warn':'bad'}">Unique bios: <b>${uniqueBios}</b> / ${count} (${pct(uniqueBios,count)})</div>`;
  
  html+=h3('Top 10 Most Common Exact Bios');
  html+=tbl(['Count','%','Bio'],sorted.slice(0,10).map(([bio,c])=>[
    `<b>${c}</b>`,`<span class="${c>3?'bad':c>1?'warn':''}">${pct(c,count)}</span>`,
    `<span class="dim" style="font-size:10px">${bio.length>150?bio.slice(0,150)+'...':bio}</span>`
  ]));
  
  html+=h3('Opening Sentence Patterns');
  const openSorted=Object.entries(openings).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  html+=tbl(['Count','%','Pattern'],openSorted.slice(0,15).map(([pat,c])=>[
    c,`<span class="${c/count>0.1?'bad':c/count>0.05?'warn':''}">${pct(c,count)}</span>`,
    `<span class="dim">${pat.slice(0,100)}</span>`
  ]));
  
  if(Object.keys(scarSentences).length>0){
    html+=h3('Scar Sentences');
    const scarSorted=Object.entries(scarSentences).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
    html+=tbl(['Count','Sentence'],scarSorted.slice(0,10).map(([s,c])=>[c,`<span class="dim">${s.slice(0,100)}</span>`]));
  }
  
  if(Object.keys(traitSentences).length>0){
    html+=h3('Trait Sentences');
    const traitSorted=Object.entries(traitSentences).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
    html+=tbl(['Count','Sentence'],traitSorted.slice(0,10).map(([s,c])=>[c,`<span class="dim">${s.slice(0,100)}</span>`]));
  }
  
  html+=h3('Bio Length Distribution');
  html+=tbl(['Sentences','Count','%'],Object.entries(lengths).sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]).map(([n,c])=>[n,c,pct(c,count)]));
  
  // Export button
  html+=`<button class="copy-btn" id="copyBiosBtn" onclick="copyAllBios()">📋 Copy all ${bios.length} bios</button>`;

  out.innerHTML=html;
  status.textContent=`Done. ${uniqueBios} unique bios out of ${count}.`;
}

function copyAllBios(){
  const bios = window._lastBios;
  if (!bios || bios.length===0) return;
  const text = bios.join("\n\n");
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(()=>{
    const btn = document.getElementById('copyBiosBtn');
    if(btn){ btn.textContent = "✓ Copied!"; setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent = `📋 Copy all ${bios.length} bios`; }, 2000); }
  }).catch(()=>alert("Copy failed"));
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  LOG ANALYSIS
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

let logCrewId=0;
function makeLogCrew(faction,day){
  logCrewId++;
  const m=G.generateCrewMember?G.generateCrewMember(faction):
    {id:logCrewId,firstName:"Crew"+logCrewId,lastName:"M",role:"deckhand",faction,tags:[]};
  m.daysAboard=0;
  return m;
}

function simLogRun(maxDays){
  const log=[];
  let day=0,fame=0,morale=70,gold=490;
  let roster=[makeLogCrew(FACTIONS_LIST[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)],0),makeLogCrew(FACTIONS_LIST[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)],0)];
  let port=PORTS_LIST[Math.floor(Math.random()*PORTS_LIST.length)];
  
  while(day<maxDays){
    // Port visit every ~7 days
    if(day%7===0&&day>0){
      port=PORTS_LIST[Math.floor(Math.random()*PORTS_LIST.length)];
      const pn=D.PORTS[port]?.name||port;
      log.push(`Arrived at ${pn}.`);
      
      // Desertion
      const upset=roster.filter(m=>(m.tags||[]).includes("upset"));
      const deserted=[];const calmed=[];
      upset.forEach(m=>{
        if(Math.random()<0.30){deserted.push(m);}
        else{m.tags=(m.tags||[]).filter(t=>t!=="upset");calmed.push(m);}
      });
      deserted.forEach(m=>{roster=roster.filter(r=>r.id!==m.id);});
      if(deserted.length===1)log.push(`${deserted[0].firstName} ${deserted[0].lastName} has left the crew.`);
      else if(deserted.length>1)log.push(`${deserted.length} crew members have deserted.`);
      if(calmed.length>0)log.push("The rest of the upset crew seem to have settled down.");
      
      // Milestones
      const newS=[],newV=[];
      roster.forEach(m=>{
        if(m.daysAboard>=50&&!(m.tags||[]).includes("seasoned")&&!(m.tags||[]).includes("veteran")){m.tags=m.tags||[];m.tags.push("seasoned");newS.push(m.firstName);}
        else if(m.daysAboard>=100&&!(m.tags||[]).includes("veteran")){m.tags=(m.tags||[]).filter(t=>t!=="seasoned");m.tags.push("veteran");newV.push(m.firstName);}
      });
      if(newS.length===1)log.push(`${newS[0]} has found their sea legs.`);
      else if(newS.length>1)log.push(`${newS.length} crew members have found their sea legs.`);
      if(newV.length===1)log.push(`${newV[0]} has served 100 days aboard. A true veteran.`);
      else if(newV.length>1)log.push(`${newV.length} crew members are now veterans.`);
      
      // Hire
      while(roster.length<8)roster.push(makeLogCrew(D.PORTS[port]?.faction||"pirate",day));
      
      // Mission
      if(Math.random()<0.7){
        const mg=100+Math.floor(Math.random()*400);gold+=mg;fame++;morale=Math.min(100,morale+3);
        log.push(`Mission complete: +${mg}g, +1 fame.`);
      }
      // Trade
      if(Math.random()<0.4){const g=GOODS[Math.floor(Math.random()*GOODS.length)];const q=2+Math.floor(Math.random()*8);log.push(`Bought ${q} ${D.RESOURCES[g]?.name||g} for ${q*30}g.`);}
      if(Math.random()<0.3){const g=GOODS[Math.floor(Math.random()*GOODS.length)];const q=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);log.push(`Sold ${q} ${D.RESOURCES[g]?.name||g} for ${q*50}g.`);}
      if(Math.random()<0.2){log.push(`Repaired ship for ${50+Math.floor(Math.random()*250)}g.`);}
      if(Math.random()<0.3)log.push("Game saved.");
    }
    
    // Combat
    if(Math.random()<0.12){
      const eFac=FACTIONS_LIST[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)];
      const eName=SHIP_NAMES[Math.floor(Math.random()*SHIP_NAMES.length)];
      if(Math.random()<0.7){
        log.push(`Victory! ${eName} defeated.`);
        const losses=Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
        if(losses>0&&roster.length>2){
          const killed=[];
          for(let i=0;i<Math.min(losses,roster.length-1);i++){const idx=Math.floor(Math.random()*roster.length);killed.push(roster.splice(idx,1)[0]);}
          if(killed.length)log.push(`Lost crew: ${killed.map(k=>k.firstName+' '+k.lastName).join(', ')}.`);
        }
        roster.forEach(m=>{
          if(m.faction===eFac&&!(m.tags||[]).includes("upset")&&Math.random()<0.15){m.tags=m.tags||[];m.tags.push("upset");
            log.push(`${m.firstName} is disturbed by the attack on ${FACTION_LABELS[eFac]||eFac} ships.`);}
        });
        if(Math.random()<0.3)log.push(`Plundered ${50+Math.floor(Math.random()*150)}g from the wreckage.`);
      }else{
        log.push(`Defeated by ${eName}. Washed ashore. All cargo lost.`);
        morale=Math.max(0,morale-15);
      }
    }
    
    // Events
    if(Math.random()<0.05){
      const ev=Math.random();
      if(ev<0.2){log.push("A violent storm batters the ship!");if(roster.length>2&&Math.random()<0.5){const k=roster.splice(Math.floor(Math.random()*roster.length),1)[0];log.push(`${k.firstName} ${k.lastName} was lost in the storm.`);}}
      else if(ev<0.3)log.push("Becalmed. The winds have died completely.");
      else if(ev<0.4)log.push(`Found a drifting wreck! Salvaged ${100+Math.floor(Math.random()*400)}g.`);
      else if(ev<0.5)log.push("A pod of whales surfaces nearby. The crew watches in wonder.");
      else if(ev<0.6)log.push("Spotted sails on the horizon. They pass without incident.");
      else if(ev<0.65){const s=makeLogCrew(FACTIONS_LIST[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)],day);s.tags=["scar_shipwreck"];roster.push(s);log.push(`Rescued ${s.firstName} ${s.lastName} from a shipwreck.`);}
    }
    
    roster.forEach(m=>m.daysAboard=(m.daysAboard||0)+1);
    day++;
  }
  return log;
}

async function runLogAnalysis(){
  const nRuns=parseInt(document.getElementById('logRuns').value)||10;
  const maxDays=parseInt(document.getElementById('logDays').value)||500;
  const fill=document.getElementById('logFill');
  const status=document.getElementById('statusB');
  const out=document.getElementById('logResults');
  
  status.textContent='Simulating...';fill.style.width='0%';
  
  const allLogs=[];
  for(let i=0;i<nRuns;i++){
    logCrewId=0;
    allLogs.push(simLogRun(maxDays));
    fill.style.width=((i+1)/nRuns*100)+'%';
    status.textContent=`Run ${i+1}/${nRuns}...`;
    await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
  }
  
  const allEntries=allLogs.flat();
  window._lastLogs = allEntries;   // store for export
  const total=allEntries.length;
  const avgPerRun=Math.round(total/nRuns);
  const avgPerDay=(total/(nRuns*maxDays)).toFixed(2);
  
  // Exact duplicates
  const exactCounts={};allEntries.forEach(e=>{exactCounts[e]=(exactCounts[e]||0)+1;});
  const exactSorted=Object.entries(exactCounts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  
  // Categories
  const cats={};allEntries.forEach(e=>{const c=classifyLog(e);cats[c]=(cats[c]||0)+1;});
  const catSorted=Object.entries(cats).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  
  // Structural patterns
  const patterns={};allEntries.forEach(e=>{const n=normalize(e);patterns[n]=(patterns[n]||0)+1;});
  const patSorted=Object.entries(patterns).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  
  // Worst spam (longest same-category streak in first 3 runs)
  const spamResults=[];
  allLogs.slice(0,3).forEach((log,ri)=>{
    let bestLen=0,bestCat='',bestStart=0,curCat='',curLen=0,curStart=0;
    log.forEach((e,i)=>{
      const c=classifyLog(e);
      if(c===curCat){curLen++;}
      else{if(curLen>bestLen){bestLen=curLen;bestCat=curCat;bestStart=curStart;}curCat=c;curLen=1;curStart=i;}
    });
    if(bestLen>2)spamResults.push({run:ri,len:bestLen,cat:bestCat,start:bestStart,entries:log.slice(bestStart,bestStart+Math.min(bestLen,6))});
  });
  
  // Render
  let html='';
  html+=h2(`📜 Log Analysis — ${nRuns} runs × ${maxDays} days`);
  html+=`<div>Total entries: <b>${total.toLocaleString()}</b> · Avg/run: <b>${avgPerRun}</b> · Avg/day: <b>${avgPerDay}</b></div>`;
  
  html+=h3('Top 20 Most Common Exact Messages');
  html+=tbl(['Count','%','Message'],exactSorted.slice(0,20).map(([msg,c])=>[
    `<b>${c}</b>`,
    `<span class="${c/total>0.05?'bad':c/total>0.02?'warn':''}">${pct(c,total)}</span>`,
    `<span class="dim" style="font-size:10px">${msg.slice(0,120)}</span>`
  ]));
  
  html+=h3('Category Distribution');
  html+=tbl(['Category','Count','%'],catSorted.map(([cat,c])=>[
    cat,c.toLocaleString(),
    `<span class="${c/total>0.10?'bad':c/total>0.05?'warn':''}">${pct(c,total)}</span>`
  ]));
  
  // Category bar chart
  html+=`<canvas id="catChart" width="700" height="250"></canvas>`;
  
  html+=h3('Top 15 Structural Patterns (normalized)');
  html+=tbl(['Count','%','Pattern'],patSorted.slice(0,15).map(([pat,c])=>[
    `<b>${c}</b>`,
    `<span class="${c/total>0.10?'bad':c/total>0.05?'warn':''}">${pct(c,total)}</span>`,
    `<span class="dim" style="font-size:10px">${pat.slice(0,100)}</span>`
  ]));
  
  if(spamResults.length>0){
    html+=h3('Worst Spam Sequences');
    spamResults.forEach(s=>{
      html+=`<div style="margin:8px 0"><span class="warn">Run ${s.run}: ${s.len}× "${s.cat}" starting at entry ${s.start}</span>`;
      html+='<div style="margin-left:16px;font-size:10px">';
      s.entries.forEach(e=>{html+=`<div class="dim">${e}</div>`;});
      html+='</div></div>';
    });
  }

  // Export button
  html+=`<button class="copy-btn" id="copyLogsBtn" onclick="copyAllLogs()">📋 Copy all ${total.toLocaleString()} log entries</button>`;

  out.innerHTML=html;
  
  // Draw category chart
  setTimeout(()=>{
    const canvas=document.getElementById('catChart');
    if(!canvas)return;
    const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
    const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
    ctx.fillStyle='#120e04';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    const pad={l:40,r:10,t:20,b:60};
    const pw=W-pad.l-pad.r,ph=H-pad.t-pad.b;
    const maxVal=catSorted[0]?catSorted[0][1]:1;
    const barW=Math.floor(pw/catSorted.length)-2;
    const colors={"arrival":"#ffd700","combat_win":"#4caf50","combat_loss":"#f44336","mission":"#2196f3",
      "trade_buy":"#a0a0a0","trade_sell":"#808080","crew_death":"#f44336","crew_upset":"#ff9800",
      "desertion":"#ff5722","crew_calmed":"#4caf50","crew_milestone":"#ffd700","save":"#606060",
      "repair":"#a0a0a0","event_storm":"#2196f3","plunder":"#ffd700","other":"#606060"};
    catSorted.forEach(([cat,c],i)=>{
      const x=pad.l+i*(barW+2);
      const h=Math.max(1,(c/maxVal)*ph);
      ctx.fillStyle=colors[cat]||'#606060';
      ctx.fillRect(x,pad.t+ph-h,barW,h);
      ctx.save();ctx.translate(x+barW/2,H-4);ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/4);
      ctx.fillStyle='#a0a0a0';ctx.font='8px monospace';ctx.textAlign='right';
      ctx.fillText(cat,0,0);ctx.restore();
      ctx.fillStyle='#a0a0a0';ctx.font='8px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.fillText(c,x+barW/2,pad.t+ph-h-4);
    });
  },100);
  
  status.textContent=`Done. ${total.toLocaleString()} entries across ${nRuns} runs.`;
}

function copyAllLogs(){
  const logs = window._lastLogs;
  if (!logs || logs.length===0) return;
  const text = logs.join("\n");
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(()=>{
    const btn = document.getElementById('copyLogsBtn');
    if(btn){ btn.textContent = "✓ Copied!"; setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent = `📋 Copy all ${logs.length} log entries`; }, 2000); }
  }).catch(()=>alert("Copy failed"));
}

</html>

<script>
const D=window.D, L=window.L, G=window.G;
const SHIPS=D.SHIPS, FACTIONS=D.FACTIONS, PORTS=D.PORTS;
const SHIPS_ORDER=Object.keys(SHIPS);

// Helpers
const randInt = (min, max) => Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
const weightedPick = (weights) => {
  const total = Object.values(weights).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  let r = Math.random() * total;
  for (const [key, weight] of Object.entries(weights)) {
    r -= weight;
    if (r <= 0) return key;
  }
  return Object.keys(weights)[0];
};

// ── Mission Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const MISSION_TYPES = {
  trade:    { combatChance: 0.00, fame: 1, morale: 2, crewRisk: "none",   duration: [4,8] },
  smuggle:  { combatChance: 0.30, fame: 1, morale: 3, crewRisk: "low",    duration: [4,8] },
  escort:   { combatChance: 0.60, fame: 2, morale: 4, crewRisk: "medium", duration: [4,8] },
  combat:   { combatChance: 1.00, fame: 3, morale: 5, crewRisk: "high",   duration: [4,8] },
  patrol:   { combatChance: 0.80, fame: 2, morale: 3, crewRisk: "medium", duration: [4,8] },
  assault:  { combatChance: 1.00, fame: 4, morale: 5, crewRisk: "veryhigh",duration: [4,8] },
};

// ── Playstyle Profiles ──────────────────────────────────────────────
const PROFILES={
  "Peaceful Trader":{
    missionWeights: { trade: 80, smuggle: 5, escort: 10, combat: 0, patrol: 5, assault: 0 },
    crewType:"mixed", alignment:"aligned", riskPref:"low",
    desc:"Avoids combat, mixed crew, aligned missions",color:"#4caf50",

  },

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SIMULATION ENGINE – Voyage-based
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function getFameTier(fame){
  if(fame>=350)return 4;if(fame>=200)return 3;if(fame>=100)return 2;if(fame>=50)return 1;return 0;
}

function getShipAtFame(fame){
  if(fame>=150)return"galleon";if(fame>=100)return"frigate";
  if(fame>=50)return"brigantine";if(fame>=20)return"sloop";
  if(fame>=5)return"cutter";return"dinghy";
}

// Simulated state – mimics the game state needed by L.processDesertion, etc.
function makeSimState(day, fame, morale, roster, currentPort, shipType, reputation) {
  return {
    day,
    fame,
    crew: { roster, morale, max: SHIPS[shipType].maxCrew },
    currentPort,
    reputation: reputation || {},
    ship: { type: shipType },
    log: [],
  };
}

// Helper to generate a single crew member
function makeCrew(faction, existingNames, hireDay, hireFame) {
  const member = G.generateCrewMember(faction, existingNames);
  member.hiredDay = hireDay;
  member.hiredFame = hireFame;
  return member;
}

function calcCrewLoss(missionType, fameTier, riskPref) {
  const riskMult = { low: 0.4, medium: 0.8, high: 1.2 }[riskPref] || 1.0;
  const base = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) + fameTier;
  let mod = 1;
  if (missionType === 'assault') mod = 2.0;
  else if (missionType === 'combat') mod = 1.5;
  else if (missionType === 'patrol' || missionType === 'escort') mod = 1.2;
  return Math.max(1, Math.floor(base * riskMult * mod));
}

function advanceDays(days, roster, morale, holdItems, day) {
  // Apply daily effects for the given number of days
  for(let d=0; d<days; d++){
    day++;
    // Morale decay
    if(morale < 30) morale = Math.max(0, morale - 1);
    // Gradual decay when morale > 50
    if(morale > 50 && d % 2 === 0) morale = Math.max(0, morale - 1);
    // Provisions consumption
    const consumption = L.getProvisionConsumptionPerDay({ crew: { roster } });
    if(holdItems.food) holdItems.food = Math.max(0, holdItems.food - consumption.food);
    if(holdItems.water) holdItems.water = Math.max(0, holdItems.water - consumption.water);
    // Check starvation (simplified)
    if(holdItems.food === 0 || holdItems.water === 0) morale = Math.max(0, morale - 1);
    // Update crew days
    roster.forEach(m => m.daysAboard = (m.daysAboard || 0) + 1);
  }
  return { day, morale, holdItems };
}

function simRun(profile, maxDays){
  const P = PROFILES[profile];
  let day=0, fame=0, morale=70, ship="dinghy";
  const roster=[], departed=[];
  const factions=["english","spanish","french","dutch","pirate"];
  const crewFaction = P.crewType==="single" ? factions[Math.floor(Math.random()*4)]
    : P.crewType==="pirate" ? "pirate" : null;

  const startFac = crewFaction || factions[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)];
  const existingNames = [];
  roster.push(makeCrew(startFac, existingNames, day, fame));
  existingNames.push(`${roster[0].firstName} ${roster[0].lastName}`);
  if(Math.random()<0.5){
    const c2 = makeCrew(startFac, existingNames, day, fame);
    roster.push(c2);
    existingNames.push(`${c2.firstName} ${c2.lastName}`);
  }

  // Provisions (high enough to not die early, but realistic)
  let holdItems = { food: 200, water: 200 };
  const reputation = {};
  Object.keys(PORTS).forEach(k=>reputation[k]=50);

  let portVisits = 0;

  while(day < maxDays){
    const fameTier = getFameTier(fame);
    const idealShip = getShipAtFame(fame);
    if(SHIPS_ORDER.indexOf(idealShip) > SHIPS_ORDER.indexOf(ship)) ship = idealShip;
    const maxCrew = SHIPS[ship].maxCrew;

    // ── 1. Travel to port ───────────────────────────────────────────
    const travelDays = randInt(3, 12);
    const result = advanceDays(travelDays, roster, morale, holdItems, day);
    day = result.day;
    morale = result.morale;
    holdItems = result.holdItems;

    // Random event during travel (storm / desertion)
    if(Math.random() < 0.05 && roster.length > 2){
      const evRoll = Math.random();
      if(evRoll < 0.15){
        // Storm: lose 1-2 crew
        const loss = Math.min(1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2), roster.length-1);
        if(loss > 0){
          const removed = L.removeRandomCrew(roster, loss);
          removed.removed.forEach(m=>{
            m.departedDay=day; m.departedFame=fame;
            m.departureReason="storm";
            m.daysServed=day-m.hiredDay;
            departed.push(m);
          });
          roster.length = 0;
          roster.push(...removed.newRoster);
          morale = Math.max(0, morale - 5);
        }
      } else if(evRoll < 0.30 && morale < 40 && roster.length > 2){
        // Desertion event: lose 2-3
        const loss = Math.min(2+Math.floor(Math.random()*2), roster.length-1);
        const removed = L.removeRandomCrew(roster, loss);
        removed.removed.forEach(m=>{
          m.departedDay=day; m.departedFame=fame;
          m.departureReason="event_deserter";
          m.daysServed=day-m.hiredDay;
          departed.push(m);
        });
        roster.length = 0;
        roster.push(...removed.newRoster);
      }
    }

    // ── 2. Port Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    portVisits++;
    morale = Math.min(100, morale + 3); // shore leave boost (reduced from +5)

    // Hire to ~70% of capacity
    const target = Math.floor(maxCrew * 0.7);
    while(roster.length < target){
      let fac;
      if(P.crewType==="single") fac=crewFaction;
      else if(P.crewType==="pirate") fac="pirate";
      else fac=factions[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)];
      const member = makeCrew(fac, existingNames, day, fame);
      existingNames.push(`${member.firstName} ${member.lastName}`);
      roster.push(member);
    }

    // Cap roster to ship max
    while(roster.length > maxCrew){
      const removed = roster.pop();
      removed.departedDay=day; removed.departedFame=fame;
      removed.departureReason="ship_downgrade";
      removed.daysServed=day-removed.hiredDay;
      departed.push(removed);
    }

    // Desertion
    const simState = makeSimState(day, fame, morale, roster, "portRoyal", ship, reputation);
    const prevRoster = roster.slice();
    const desertionResult = L.processDesertion(roster, morale, "portRoyal", simState);
    roster.length = 0;
    roster.push(...desertionResult.roster);
    // Find deserters by comparing IDs
    const prevIds = new Set(prevRoster.map(m => m.id));
    const newIds = new Set(roster.map(m => m.id));
    const deserterIds = [...prevIds].filter(id => !newIds.has(id));
    deserterIds.forEach(id => {
      const m = prevRoster.find(m => m.id === id);
      if (m) {
        m.departedDay=day; m.departedFame=fame;
        m.departureReason="deserted";
        m.daysServed=day-m.hiredDay;
        departed.push(m);
      }
    });

    // Positive traits
    const traitResult = L.processPositiveTraits(roster, simState);
    roster.length = 0;
    roster.push(...traitResult.roster);

    // ── 3. Choose and Resolve Mission ──────────────────────────────
    const missionKey = weightedPick(P.missionWeights);
    const mission = MISSION_TYPES[missionKey];
    const missionDur = randInt(mission.duration[0], mission.duration[1]);

    // Advance mission days
    const res2 = advanceDays(missionDur, roster, morale, holdItems, day);
    day = res2.day;
    morale = res2.morale;
    holdItems = res2.holdItems;

    // Combat check
    if(Math.random() < mission.combatChance && roster.length > 0){
      const loss = calcCrewLoss(missionKey, fameTier, P.riskPref);
      if(loss > 0 && roster.length > loss){
        const removed = L.removeRandomCrew(roster, loss);
        removed.removed.forEach(m=>{
          m.departedDay=day; m.departedFame=fame;
          m.departureReason="combat_death";
          m.daysServed=day-m.hiredDay;
          departed.push(m);
        });
        roster.length = 0;
        roster.push(...removed.newRoster);
        morale = Math.max(0, morale - (5 + fameTier));
      } else {
        morale = Math.min(100, morale + 5); // victory morale
      }

      // Upset tagging (15% chance for matching faction)
      const enemyFaction = (P.alignment === "aligned") 
        ? (crewFaction ? FACTIONS[crewFaction]?.rivalFactions?.[Math.floor(Math.random()*FACTIONS[crewFaction]?.rivalFactions?.length)] || "pirate" : "pirate")
        : (P.alignment === "opposed") 
          ? crewFaction || factions[Math.floor(Math.random()*4)]
          : factions[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)];
      roster.forEach(m=>{
        if(m.faction===enemyFaction && !L.hasTag(m,"upset") && !L.hasTag(m,"loyal")){
          if(Math.random()<0.15){
            const updated = L.addTag(m, "upset");
            Object.assign(m, updated);
          }
        }
      });

      // Alignment morale penalty
      const simStateForAlign = makeSimState(day, fame, morale, roster, "portRoyal", ship, reputation);
      const alignMod = L.getAlignmentModifier(simStateForAlign, enemyFaction);
      const penalty = Math.round(3 * alignMod);
      morale = Math.max(0, morale - penalty);
    } else {
      morale = Math.min(100, morale + mission.morale);
    }

    fame += mission.fame;
  }

  // Mark survivors
  roster.forEach(m=>{
    m.departedDay=null; m.departedFame=null;
    m.departureReason="alive";
    m.daysServed=day-m.hiredDay;
  });

  return{roster,departed,finalDay:day,finalFame:fame,finalMorale:morale,portVisits};
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  ANALYSIS & CHARTS (unchanged)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function analyzeRuns(runs,maxDays){
  const allCrew=[];
  runs.forEach(r=>{
    [...r.roster,...r.departed].forEach(m=>allCrew.push(m));
  });

  const lifespans=allCrew.map(m=>m.daysServed);
  const alive=allCrew.filter(m=>m.departureReason==="alive");
  const dead=allCrew.filter(m=>m.departureReason!=="alive");

  const reasons={};
  dead.forEach(m=>{reasons[m.departureReason]=(reasons[m.departureReason]||0)+1;});

  const survivalCurve=[];
  for(let d=0;d<=maxDays;d+=5){
    const totalHiredByD=allCrew.filter(m=>m.hiredDay<=d).length;
    const aliveAtD=allCrew.filter(m=>m.hiredDay<=d&&(m.departureReason==="alive"||m.departedDay>d)).length;
    survivalCurve.push({day:d,pct:totalHiredByD>0?aliveAtD/totalHiredByD:1});
  }

  const origCrew=allCrew.filter(m=>m.hiredDay===0);
  const origAtFame50=origCrew.filter(m=>m.departureReason==="alive"||(m.departedFame!==null&&m.departedFame>=50)).length;
  const origAtFame100=origCrew.filter(m=>m.departureReason==="alive"||(m.departedFame!==null&&m.departedFame>=100)).length;

  const longestServed=Math.max(...lifespans,0);
  const runsWithVeteran=runs.filter(r=>{
    return[...r.roster,...r.departed].some(m=>m.daysServed>=100);
  }).length;

  const totalDepartures=dead.length;
  const totalDays=runs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.finalDay,0);

  const desertions=dead.filter(m=>m.departureReason==="deserted").length;
  const combatDeaths=dead.filter(m=>m.departureReason==="combat_death").length;
  const avgCrewSize=runs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.roster.length,0)/runs.length;

  return{
    totalCrew:allCrew.length,
    avgLifespan:Math.round(lifespans.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/Math.max(1,lifespans.length)),
    medianLifespan:lifespans.sort((a,b)=>a-b)[Math.floor(lifespans.length/2)]||0,
    longestServed,
    origCrewCount:origCrew.length,
    origAtFame50Pct:origCrew.length>0?Math.round(origAtFame50/origCrew.length*100):0,
    origAtFame100Pct:origCrew.length>0?Math.round(origAtFame100/origCrew.length*100):0,
    runsWithVeteranPct:Math.round(runsWithVeteran/runs.length*100),
    turnoverPer10Days:totalDays>0?Math.round(totalDepartures/totalDays*100)/10:0,
    desertionsPer10Ports:runs.length>0?Math.round(desertions/runs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.portVisits,0)*100)/10:0,
    combatDeathsPer10Battles:0,
    reasons,
    survivalCurve,
    avgFinalCrew:avgCrewSize,
    avgFinalFame:Math.round(runs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.finalFame,0)/runs.length),
  };
}

function drawSurvivalChart(canvasId,allAnalysis,maxDays){
  const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);
  const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
  const pad={l:50,r:20,t:20,b:30};
  const pw=W-pad.l-pad.r,ph=H-pad.t-pad.b;
  ctx.fillStyle="#0d1620";ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  ctx.strokeStyle="#1a2a3a";ctx.lineWidth=0.5;
  for(let p=0;p<=100;p+=25){
    const y=pad.t+ph-(p/100)*ph;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad.l,y);ctx.lineTo(pad.l+pw,y);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle="#606060";ctx.font="9px monospace";ctx.textAlign="right";
    ctx.fillText(p+"%",pad.l-4,y+3);
  }
  for(let d=0;d<=maxDays;d+=100){
    const x=pad.l+(d/maxDays)*pw;
    ctx.fillStyle="#606060";ctx.font="9px monospace";ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText(d,x,H-4);
  }

  Object.entries(allAnalysis).forEach(([name,a])=>{
    const color=PROFILES[name].color;
    ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.globalAlpha=0.9;
    ctx.beginPath();
    a.survivalCurve.forEach((pt,i)=>{
      const x=pad.l+(pt.day/maxDays)*pw;
      const y=pad.t+ph-pt.pct*ph;
      i===0?ctx.moveTo(x,y):ctx.lineTo(x,y);
    });
    ctx.stroke();ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  });

  let ly=pad.t+10;
  ctx.font="9px monospace";
  Object.entries(allAnalysis).forEach(([name])=>{
    ctx.fillStyle=PROFILES[name].color;
    ctx.fillRect(pad.l+8,ly-4,12,3);
    ctx.fillStyle="#a0a0a0";ctx.textAlign="left";
    ctx.fillText(name,pad.l+24,ly);ly+=12;
  });
}

function drawReasonsChart(canvasId,allAnalysis){
  const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);
  const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
  ctx.fillStyle="#0d1620";ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  const profiles=Object.keys(allAnalysis);
  const allReasons=["combat_death","deserted","storm","event_deserter","ship_downgrade"];
  const reasonColors={"combat_death":"#f44336","deserted":"#ff9800","storm":"#2196f3","event_deserter":"#9c27b0","ship_downgrade":"#606060"};

  const barW=Math.floor((W-80)/profiles.length);
  const maxH=H-60;

  profiles.forEach((name,pi)=>{
    const a=allAnalysis[name];
    const total=Object.values(a.reasons).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)||1;
    let y=30;
    const x=40+pi*barW;

    allReasons.forEach(reason=>{
      const count=a.reasons[reason]||0;
      const h=Math.max(0,(count/total)*maxH);
      ctx.fillStyle=reasonColors[reason]||"#404040";
      ctx.fillRect(x+4,y,barW-8,h);
      if(h>12){
        ctx.fillStyle="#000";ctx.font="8px monospace";ctx.textAlign="center";
        ctx.fillText(Math.round(count/total*100)+"%",x+barW/2,y+h/2+3);
      }
      y+=h;
    });

    ctx.fillStyle=PROFILES[name].color;ctx.font="8px monospace";ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText(name.split(" ")[0],x+barW/2,H-4);
  });

  let lx=10,ly=12;
  ctx.font="8px monospace";
  allReasons.forEach(r=>{
    ctx.fillStyle=reasonColors[r]||"#404040";
    ctx.fillRect(lx,ly-4,8,8);
    ctx.fillStyle="#a0a0a0";ctx.textAlign="left";
    ctx.fillText(r.replace(/_/g," "),lx+12,ly+3);
    lx+=100;if(lx>W-100){lx=10;ly+=14;}
  });
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  MAIN
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

async function runSim(){
  const btn=document.getElementById("runBtn");btn.disabled=true;
  const fill=document.getElementById("progressFill");
  const status=document.getElementById("status");
  const nRuns=parseInt(document.getElementById("nRuns").value)||100;
  const maxDays=parseInt(document.getElementById("maxDays").value)||1000;

  const allAnalysis={};
  const allRuns={};
  const profileNames=Object.keys(PROFILES);
  let done=0,total=profileNames.length*nRuns;

  for(const name of profileNames){
    const runs=[];
    for(let i=0;i<nRuns;i++){
      runs.push(simRun(name,maxDays));
      done++;
      if(done%10===0){
        fill.style.width=(done/total*100)+"%";
        status.textContent=`${name}: ${i+1}/${nRuns} (${Math.round(done/total*100)}%)`;
        await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
      }
    }
    allRuns[name]=runs;
    allAnalysis[name]=analyzeRuns(runs,maxDays);
    status.textContent=`✓ ${name} complete`;
    await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
  }

  fill.style.width="100%";status.textContent="✓ Rendering results...";

  const out=document.getElementById("results");out.style.display="block";
  let html="";

  html+=`<h2>📊 Crew Lifecycle Summary (${nRuns} runs × ${maxDays} days)</h2>`;
  html+="<table><tr><th>Profile</th><th>Avg Lifespan</th><th>Median</th><th>Longest</th>"
    +"<th>Turnover/10d</th><th>Orig @F50</th><th>Orig @F100</th>"
    +"<th>Runs w/ Veteran</th><th>Avg Final Crew</th><th>Avg Fame</th></tr>";

  profileNames.forEach(name=>{
    const a=allAnalysis[name];const c=PROFILES[name].color;
    html+=`<tr><td style="color:${c};font-weight:bold">${name}</td>`
      +`<td class="val">${a.avgLifespan}d</td>`
      +`<td class="val">${a.medianLifespan}d</td>`
      +`<td class="val">${a.longestServed}d</td>`
      +`<td class="val ${a.turnoverPer10Days>2?'bad':a.turnoverPer10Days>1?'warn':'good'}">${a.turnoverPer10Days}</td>`
      +`<td class="val ${a.origAtFame50Pct<30?'bad':a.origAtFame50Pct<60?'warn':'good'}">${a.origAtFame50Pct}%</td>`
      +`<td class="val ${a.origAtFame100Pct<10?'bad':a.origAtFame100Pct<30?'warn':'good'}">${a.origAtFame100Pct}%</td>`
      +`<td class="val ${a.runsWithVeteranPct<50?'warn':'good'}">${a.runsWithVeteranPct}%</td>`
      +`<td class="val">${Math.round(a.avgFinalCrew)}</td>`
      +`<td class="val">${a.avgFinalFame}</td></tr>`;
  });
  html+="</table>";

  html+=`<h2>💀 Departure Reasons (% of all departures)</h2>`;
  const allReasons=["combat_death","deserted","storm","event_deserter","ship_downgrade"];
  html+="<table><tr><th>Profile</th>"+allReasons.map(r=>`<th>${r.replace(/_/g," ")}</th>`).join("")+"<th>Total Lost</th></tr>";
  profileNames.forEach(name=>{
    const a=allAnalysis[name];const total=Object.values(a.reasons).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)||1;
    html+=`<tr><td style="color:${PROFILES[name].color}">${name}</td>`;
    allReasons.forEach(r=>{
      const c=a.reasons[r]||0;const p=Math.round(c/total*100);
      html+=`<td class="val ${p>40?'bad':p>20?'warn':''}">${p}% (${c})</td>`;
    });
    html+=`<td class="val">${total}</td></tr>`;
  });
  html+="</table>";

  html+=`<h2>❤️ Attachment Analysis</h2>`;
  html+="<table><tr><th>Profile</th><th>% runs with 100d+ veteran</th><th>% runs with 200d+ veteran</th><th>Avg days of longest-serving</th></tr>";
  profileNames.forEach(name=>{
    const runs=allRuns[name];
    const v100=runs.filter(r=>[...r.roster,...r.departed].some(m=>m.daysServed>=100)).length;
    const v200=runs.filter(r=>[...r.roster,...r.departed].some(m=>m.daysServed>=200)).length;
    const longestPerRun=runs.map(r=>Math.max(...[...r.roster,...r.departed].map(m=>m.daysServed),0));
    const avgLongest=Math.round(longestPerRun.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/runs.length);
    html+=`<tr><td style="color:${PROFILES[name].color}">${name}</td>`
      +`<td class="val ${v100/runs.length<0.5?'warn':'good'}">${Math.round(v100/runs.length*100)}%</td>`
      +`<td class="val ${v200/runs.length<0.3?'warn':'good'}">${Math.round(v200/runs.length*100)}%</td>`
      +`<td class="val">${avgLongest}d</td></tr>`;
  });
  html+="</table>";

  html+=`<h2>📈 Charts</h2><div class="chart-grid">`;
  html+=`<div><h3>Crew Survival Curve (% alive vs days since hire)</h3><canvas id="chartSurvival" width="560" height="360"></canvas></div>`;
  html+=`<div><h3>Departure Reasons Breakdown</h3><canvas id="chartReasons" width="560" height="360"></canvas></div>`;
  html+=`</div>`;

  html+=`<h2>🎯 Balance Assessment</h2>`;
  html+=`<div class="dim" style="margin-bottom:8px">Target: Faction Loyalist should have at least 1-2 original crew at Fame 100. Turncoat should have high turnover (that's the consequence).</div>`;
  profileNames.forEach(name=>{
    const a=allAnalysis[name];
    let verdict,cls;
    if(name==="Turncoat"){
      verdict=a.turnoverPer10Days>2?"✅ High turnover (intended consequence)":"⚠ Turnover too low — no consequence for attacking own faction";
      cls=a.turnoverPer10Days>2?"good":"warn";
    } else if(name==="Faction Loyalist"){
      verdict=a.origAtFame100Pct>=20?"✅ Crew survives — attachment possible":"❌ Crew dies too fast — loyalty not rewarded";
      cls=a.origAtFame100Pct>=20?"good":"bad";
    } else if(name==="Peaceful Trader"){
      verdict=a.origAtFame100Pct>=40?"✅ Very stable crew":"⚠ Trading should be safest — crew dying too fast";
      cls=a.origAtFame100Pct>=40?"good":"warn";
    } else {
      verdict=a.runsWithVeteranPct>=50?"✅ Veterans possible":"⚠ Turnover may be too high";
      cls=a.runsWithVeteranPct>=50?"good":"warn";
    }
    html+=`<div class="${cls}" style="margin-bottom:4px"><b>${name}:</b> ${verdict} (avg lifespan: ${a.avgLifespan}d, orig@F100: ${a.origAtFame100Pct}%)</div>`;
  });

  out.innerHTML=html;

  drawSurvivalChart("chartSurvival",allAnalysis,maxDays);
  drawReasonsChart("chartReasons",allAnalysis);

  // Copy button
  const copyBtn = document.createElement("button");
  copyBtn.className = "btn-copy";
  copyBtn.textContent = "📋 Copy Results";
  copyBtn.onclick = () => {
    let text = "BROADSIDE — CREW LIFECYCLE SIMULATOR RESULTS (Voyage Model)\n";
    text += "================================================\n\n";
    text += `Crew Lifecycle Summary (${nRuns} runs × ${maxDays} days)\n`;
    text += "Profile\tAvg Lifespan\tMedian\tLongest\tTurnover/10d\tOrig @F50\tOrig @F100\tRuns w/ Veteran\tAvg Final Crew\tAvg Fame\n";
    profileNames.forEach(name=>{
      const a=allAnalysis[name];
      text += `${name}\t${a.avgLifespan}d\t${a.medianLifespan}d\t${a.longestServed}d\t${a.turnoverPer10Days}\t${a.origAtFame50Pct}%\t${a.origAtFame100Pct}%\t${a.runsWithVeteranPct}%\t${Math.round(a.avgFinalCrew)}\t${a.avgFinalFame}\n`;
    });
    text += "\nDeparture Reasons (% of all departures)\n";
    text += "Profile\t" + allReasons.map(r=>r.replace(/_/g," ")).join("\t") + "\tTotal Lost\n";
    profileNames.forEach(name=>{
      const a=allAnalysis[name];
      const total=Object.values(a.reasons).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)||1;
      text += `${name}`;
      allReasons.forEach(r=>{
        const c=a.reasons[r]||0;
        const p=Math.round(c/total*100);
        text += `\t${p}% (${c})`;
      });
      text += `\t${total}\n`;
    });
    text += "\nAttachment Analysis\n";
    text += "Profile\t% runs with 100d+ veteran\t% runs with 200d+ veteran\tAvg days of longest-serving\n";
    profileNames.forEach(name=>{
      const runs=allRuns[name];
      const v100=runs.filter(r=>[...r.roster,...r.departed].some(m=>m.daysServed>=100)).length;
      const v200=runs.filter(r=>[...r.roster,...r.departed].some(m=>m.daysServed>=200)).length;
      const longestPerRun=runs.map(r=>Math.max(...[...r.roster,...r.departed].map(m=>m.daysServed),0));
      const avgLongest=Math.round(longestPerRun.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/runs.length);
      text += `${name}\t${Math.round(v100/runs.length*100)}%\t${Math.round(v200/runs.length*100)}%\t${avgLongest}d\n`;
    });
    text += "\nBalance Assessment\n";
    profileNames.forEach(name=>{
      const a=allAnalysis[name];
      let verdict;
      if(name==="Turncoat") verdict=a.turnoverPer10Days>2?"✅ High turnover (intended consequence)":"⚠ Turnover too low — no consequence for attacking own faction";
      else if(name==="Faction Loyalist") verdict=a.origAtFame100Pct>=20?"✅ Crew survives — attachment possible":"❌ Crew dies too fast — loyalty not rewarded";
      else if(name==="Peaceful Trader") verdict=a.origAtFame100Pct>=40?"✅ Very stable crew":"⚠ Trading should be safest — crew dying too fast";
      else verdict=a.runsWithVeteranPct>=50?"✅ Veterans possible":"⚠ Turnover may be too high";
      text += `${name}: ${verdict} (avg lifespan: ${a.avgLifespan}d, orig@F100: ${a.origAtFame100Pct}%)\n`;
    });

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(()=>{
      const msg = document.getElementById("copy-msg");
      if(msg) msg.style.display="inline";
      setTimeout(()=>{ if(msg) msg.style.display="none"; }, 2000);
    }).catch(()=>{
      const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
      ta.value = text;
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      document.execCommand("copy");
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
      const msg = document.getElementById("copy-msg");
      if(msg) msg.style.display="inline";
      setTimeout(()=>{ if(msg) msg.style.display="none"; }, 2000);
    });
  };

  const resultsDiv = document.getElementById("results");
  resultsDiv.appendChild(copyBtn);
  const msgSpan = document.createElement("span");
  msgSpan.id = "copy-msg";
  msgSpan.textContent = "Copied!";
  copyBtn.parentNode.insertBefore(msgSpan, copyBtn.nextSibling);

  status.textContent=`✓ Done. ${Object.keys(allAnalysis).length} profiles × ${nRuns} runs.`;
  btn.disabled=false;
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
