function switchTab(id, el){
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('tab-'+id).classList.add('active');
  el.classList.add('active');
}

function combos(arr, maxCount){
  const result=[];
  function rec(start, picked){
    if(picked.length<=maxCount) result.push([...picked]);
    if(picked.length===maxCount) return;
    for(let i=start;i<arr.length;i++){
      picked.push(arr[i]); rec(i+1,picked); picked.pop();
    }
  }
  rec(0,[]);
  return result;
}

function cartesian(groups){
  let out=[[]];
  for(const group of groups){
    const next=[];
    for(const prev of out){
      for(const g of group) next.push(prev.concat(g));
    }
    out=next;
  }
  return out;
}

function eligibleItems(shipKey, slot){
  const ship=SHIPS[shipKey];
  return Object.entries(EQUIPMENT)
    .filter(([k,e])=>e.slot===slot && e.minHull<=ship.maxHull)
    .map(([k])=>k);
}

function enumerateCombos(shipKey){
  const ship=SHIPS[shipKey];
  const groups=[];
  for(const slot of SLOT_ORDER){
    const count=ship.slots[slot]||0;
    if(count<=0) continue;
    const elig=eligibleItems(shipKey,slot);
    groups.push(combos(elig,count));
  }
  return groups.length ? cartesian(groups) : [[]];
}

function applyCombo(shipKey, combo){
  const base=SHIPS[shipKey];
  const stats={
    maxHull:base.maxHull, maxCrew:base.maxCrew, cannons:base.cannons,
    speed:base.speed, maxDays:base.maxDays, holdCapacity:base.holdCapacity,
  };
  const effects={
    hullPct:0, holdPct:0, repairCostPct:0, stormHullImmune:0, calmImmune:0,
    crewDmgPct:0, hullDmgPct:0, precisionHitPct:0, missionCombatFameBonus:0,
    combatHeatMult:1, contrabandAvoidChance:0, crewLossPct:0, repGainBonus:0,
    longVoyageDayReduction:0,
  };
  let cost=0;
  for(const key of combo){
    const e=EQUIPMENT[key]; cost+=e.cost;
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(e.effects)){
      if(k==='hullPct') effects.hullPct+=v;
      else if(k==='holdPct') effects.holdPct+=v;
      else if(k==='combatHeatMult') effects.combatHeatMult*=v;
      else if(k in stats) stats[k]+=v;
      else effects[k]=(effects[k]||0)+v;
    }
  }
  stats.maxHull=Math.round(base.maxHull*(1+effects.hullPct));
  stats.holdCapacity=Math.round(base.holdCapacity*(1+effects.holdPct));
  stats.speed=Math.max(1,stats.speed);
  stats.maxDays=Math.max(1,stats.maxDays);

  const combat = stats.maxHull*0.35 + stats.cannons*8 + stats.maxCrew*0.6 + stats.speed*2
    + (effects.precisionHitPct>0 ? stats.cannons*8*0.12 : 0)
    + (effects.crewDmgPct>0 ? 20 : 0)
    + (effects.hullDmgPct<0 ? -10 : 0)
    + (effects.crewLossPct<0 ? 35 : 0);
  const trade = stats.holdCapacity*0.8 + stats.speed*10 + stats.maxDays*8;
  const smuggle = trade + effects.contrabandAvoidChance*150 - (effects.combatHeatMult-1)*75;
  const travel = stats.speed*12 + stats.maxDays*10 + effects.longVoyageDayReduction*25;
  const certainty = travel + effects.stormHullImmune*80 + effects.calmImmune*80 + (effects.repairCostPct>0?-20:0);
  const fameRush = combat + effects.missionCombatFameBonus*90 - (effects.combatHeatMult-1)*45;

  return { shipKey, shipName:base.name, tier:base.tier, combo, stats, effects, cost,
    scores:{combat,trade,smuggle,travel,certainty,fameRush} };
}

function analyze(){
  const rows=[];
  for(const shipKey of Object.keys(SHIPS)){
    for(const combo of enumerateCombos(shipKey)) rows.push(applyCombo(shipKey, combo));
  }
  return rows;
}

function fmt(n){ return Number.isInteger(n) ? String(n) : n.toFixed(1); }
function pct(n){ return (n*100).toFixed(1)+"%"; }
function itemPills(combo){
  if(!combo.length) return '<span class="faint">none</span>';
  return combo.map(k=>`<span class="pill ${EQUIPMENT[k].slot}" title="${EQUIPMENT[k].slot}">${EQUIPMENT[k].name}</span>`).join(' ');
}
function statLine(r){
  const s=r.stats;
  return `H${s.maxHull} · C${s.cannons} · Crew${s.maxCrew} · Sp${s.speed} · D${s.maxDays} · Hold${s.holdCapacity}`;
}
function table(headers, rows){
  return '<table><tr>'+headers.map(h=>`<th>${h}</th>`).join('')+'</tr>'+rows.map(r=>'<tr>'+r.map(c=>`<td>${c}</td>`).join('')+'</tr>').join('')+'</table>';
}
function tableScroll(headers, rows){ return '<div class="scroll">'+table(headers,rows)+'</div>'; }
function byScore(rows, archetype){ return [...rows].sort((a,b)=>ARCHETYPES[archetype].score(b)-ARCHETYPES[archetype].score(a)); }
function baselineFor(rows, shipKey){ return rows.find(r=>r.shipKey===shipKey && r.combo.length===0); }
function dominates(a,b,thresholdPct=0){
  const keys=['maxHull','maxCrew','cannons','speed','maxDays','holdCapacity'];
  const mult=1+thresholdPct/100;
  return keys.every(k=>a.stats[k] >= b.stats[k]*mult) && keys.some(k=>a.stats[k] > b.stats[k]*mult);
}
function nearDominates(a,b,tolerancePct=10){
  const keys=['maxHull','maxCrew','cannons','speed','maxDays','holdCapacity'];
  const tol=1-tolerancePct/100;
  return keys.every(k=>a.stats[k] >= b.stats[k]*tol) && keys.filter(k=>a.stats[k] > b.stats[k]).length>=4;
}
function mainstreamBuilds(rows){
  const picks=[];
  for(const shipKey of Object.keys(SHIPS)){
    const shipRows=rows.filter(r=>r.shipKey===shipKey);
    const base=baselineFor(rows,shipKey);
    picks.push({...base, label:'Baseline'});
    for(const a of Object.keys(ARCHETYPES)){
      picks.push({...byScore(shipRows,a)[0], label:ARCHETYPES[a].name});
    }
  }
  // Dedup by ship + combo
  const seen=new Set();
  return picks.filter(r=>{const key=r.shipKey+'|'+r.combo.join(','); if(seen.has(key))return false; seen.add(key); return true;});
}

function runAnalysis(){
  const rows=analyze();
  const outclassPct=Number(document.getElementById('outclassPct').value)||0;
  const nearPct=Number(document.getElementById('nearPct').value)||10;
  const gainPct=Number(document.getElementById('gainPct').value)||35;
  const topN=Number(document.getElementById('topN').value)||12;

  renderSummary(rows);
  renderOutliers(rows,outclassPct,nearPct,gainPct);
  renderArchetypes(rows,topN);
  renderShips(rows);
  renderItems(rows);
  renderData();
}

function renderSummary(rows){
  const total=rows.length;
  const byShip=Object.keys(SHIPS).map(k=>[SHIPS[k].name, rows.filter(r=>r.shipKey===k).length]);
  const totalSlots=Object.values(SHIPS).reduce((a,s)=>a+Object.values(s.slots).reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0),0);
  const structural=Object.values(EQUIPMENT).filter(e=>!e.removable).length;
  const removable=Object.values(EQUIPMENT).filter(e=>e.removable).length;

  let html='<div class="panel"><h2>Summary</h2>';
  html+='<div class="summary-grid">';
  html+=`<div class="metric-card"><div class="dim">Legal combinations</div><div class="num">${total}</div></div>`;
  html+=`<div class="metric-card"><div class="dim">Ships</div><div class="num">${Object.keys(SHIPS).length}</div></div>`;
  html+=`<div class="metric-card"><div class="dim">Equipment items</div><div class="num">${Object.keys(EQUIPMENT).length}</div><div class="dim">${removable} removable · ${structural} structural</div></div>`;
  html+=`<div class="metric-card"><div class="dim">Total ship slots</div><div class="num">${totalSlots}</div></div>`;
  html+='</div>';
  html+='<p class="note"><b class="gold">Current balance intent:</b> Fluyt should be trade king, Ship of the Line should be combat king, Galleon should be heavy hybrid, Merchantman should be mid-game cargo specialist.</p>';
  html+=table(['Ship','Tier','Slots','Legal combos','Base stats'], byShip.map(([name,count])=>{
    const key=Object.keys(SHIPS).find(k=>SHIPS[k].name===name); const s=SHIPS[key];
    return [name, s.tier, SLOT_ORDER.map(sl=>`${sl[0].toUpperCase()}:${s.slots[sl]||0}`).join(' '), count, `H${s.maxHull} C${s.cannons} Crew${s.maxCrew} Sp${s.speed} D${s.maxDays} Hold${s.holdCapacity}`];
  }));
  html+='</div>';
  document.getElementById('tab-summary').innerHTML=html;
}

function renderOutliers(rows,outclassPct,nearPct,gainPct){
  const full=[]; const near=[]; const suspicious=[]; const mainstream=mainstreamBuilds(rows);
  for(const a of mainstream){
    for(const b of mainstream){
      if(a.shipKey===b.shipKey) continue;
      if(a.tier>=b.tier) continue; // lower tier outclassing higher tier only
      if(dominates(a,b,outclassPct)) full.push({a,b});
      else if(nearDominates(a,b,nearPct)) near.push({a,b});
    }
  }
  for(const shipKey of Object.keys(SHIPS)){
    const base=baselineFor(rows,shipKey);
    const shipRows=rows.filter(r=>r.shipKey===shipKey);
    for(const arch of Object.keys(ARCHETYPES)){
      const best=byScore(shipRows,arch)[0];
      const gain=(ARCHETYPES[arch].score(best)/ARCHETYPES[arch].score(base)-1)*100;
      if(gain>=gainPct) suspicious.push({ship:SHIPS[shipKey].name, arch, best, base, gain});
    }
  }

  let html='<div class="panel"><h2>Outliers & Balance Warnings</h2>';
  html+=`<p class="note">Checks mainstream builds only: baseline + best archetype build per ship. This prevents noise from thousands of deliberately bad combinations.</p>`;
  html+=`<h3>Strict outclassing: lower-tier build beats higher-tier build in every core stat</h3>`;
  if(!full.length) html+='<p class="good">No strict lower-tier outclassing detected.</p>';
  else html+=tableScroll(['Lower-tier build','Higher-tier build being outclassed','Stats'], full.map(x=>[
    `<b>${x.a.shipName}</b> T${x.a.tier}<br>${itemPills(x.a.combo)}`,
    `<b>${x.b.shipName}</b> T${x.b.tier}<br>${itemPills(x.b.combo)}`,
    `<span class="good">${statLine(x.a)}</span><br><span class="bad">${statLine(x.b)}</span>`
  ]));

  html+=`<h3>Near-outclassing: lower-tier build is within ${nearPct}% on every stat and better on 4+ stats</h3>`;
  if(!near.length) html+='<p class="good">No near-outclassing detected.</p>';
  else html+=tableScroll(['Lower-tier build','Higher-tier comparison','Stats'], near.slice(0,80).map(x=>[
    `<b>${x.a.shipName}</b> T${x.a.tier}<br>${itemPills(x.a.combo)}`,
    `<b>${x.b.shipName}</b> T${x.b.tier}<br>${itemPills(x.b.combo)}`,
    `<span class="warn">${statLine(x.a)}</span><br><span class="dim">${statLine(x.b)}</span>`
  ]));

  html+=`<h3>Suspicious gains vs naked baseline (>${gainPct}%)</h3>`;
  suspicious.sort((a,b)=>b.gain-a.gain);
  if(!suspicious.length) html+='<p class="good">No suspicious high-gain builds above threshold.</p>';
  else html+=tableScroll(['Ship','Archetype','Gain','Best build','Stats'], suspicious.map(s=>[
    s.ship, ARCHETYPES[s.arch].name, `<span class="warn">+${s.gain.toFixed(1)}%</span>`, itemPills(s.best.combo), statLine(s.best)
  ]));
  html+='</div>';
  document.getElementById('tab-outliers').innerHTML=html;
}

function renderArchetypes(rows,topN){
  let html='<div class="panel"><h2>Top Min-Max Builds by Archetype</h2>';
  for(const arch of Object.keys(ARCHETYPES)){
    const top=byScore(rows,arch).slice(0,topN);
    html+=`<h3>${ARCHETYPES[arch].name}</h3><p class="note">${ARCHETYPES[arch].desc}</p>`;
    html+=tableScroll(['Rank','Ship','Score','Stats','Build','Flags'], top.map((r,i)=>[
      i+1, `<b>${r.shipName}</b> <span class="dim">T${r.tier}</span>`, fmt(ARCHETYPES[arch].score(r)), statLine(r), itemPills(r.combo), flagText(r)
    ]));
  }
  html+='</div>';
  document.getElementById('tab-archetypes').innerHTML=html;
}

function flagText(r){
  const f=[];
  if(r.effects.stormHullImmune) f.push('storm-safe');
  if(r.effects.calmImmune) f.push('calm-safe');
  if(r.effects.contrabandAvoidChance) f.push('smuggler');
  if(r.effects.missionCombatFameBonus) f.push('fame+heat');
  if(r.effects.crewLossPct<0) f.push('crew-safe');
  if(r.effects.repGainBonus) f.push('rep+');
  if(r.effects.longVoyageDayReduction) f.push('long-route');
  if(r.effects.repairCostPct>0) f.push('repair-cost+');
  return f.map(x=>`<span class="pill">${x}</span>`).join(' ');
}

function renderShips(rows){
  let html='<div class="panel"><h2>Best Builds Per Ship</h2>';
  for(const shipKey of Object.keys(SHIPS)){
    const shipRows=rows.filter(r=>r.shipKey===shipKey);
    const base=baselineFor(rows,shipKey);
    html+=`<h3>${SHIPS[shipKey].name} <span class="dim">T${SHIPS[shipKey].tier}</span></h3>`;
    html+=table(['Archetype','Score','Gain vs baseline','Stats','Build'], Object.keys(ARCHETYPES).map(arch=>{
      const best=byScore(shipRows,arch)[0];
      const score=ARCHETYPES[arch].score(best); const baseScore=ARCHETYPES[arch].score(base);
      return [ARCHETYPES[arch].name, fmt(score), `<span class="${score>=baseScore?'good':'bad'}">${((score/baseScore-1)*100).toFixed(1)}%</span>`, statLine(best), itemPills(best.combo)];
    }));
  }
  html+='</div>';
  document.getElementById('tab-ships').innerHTML=html;
}

function renderItems(rows){
  let html='<div class="panel"><h2>Item Usage & Underwhelming Candidates</h2>';
  html+='<p class="note">Counts how often each item appears in best-per-ship archetype builds. Items with zero appearances may still be situational, but should get extra tooltip clarity or later simulation.</p>';
  const rowsOut=[];
  for(const [key,e] of Object.entries(EQUIPMENT)){
    const appearances=rows.filter(r=>r.combo.includes(key)).length;
    const bestCounts={};
    for(const arch of Object.keys(ARCHETYPES)){
      bestCounts[arch]=0;
      for(const shipKey of Object.keys(SHIPS)){
        const best=byScore(rows.filter(r=>r.shipKey===shipKey),arch)[0];
        if(best.combo.includes(key)) bestCounts[arch]++;
      }
    }
    const useScore=Object.values(bestCounts).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
    rowsOut.push([`<span class="pill ${e.slot}">${e.name}</span>`, e.slot, e.removable?'yes':'structural', e.fame, e.minHull, appearances, useScore, Object.entries(bestCounts).map(([a,c])=>`${a}:${c}`).join(' · '), describeEffects(e.effects)]);
  }
  rowsOut.sort((a,b)=>b[6]-a[6]);
  html+=tableScroll(['Item','Slot','Removable','Fame','Min Hull','Combo appearances','Best-build hits','By archetype','Effects'], rowsOut);
  html+='</div>';
  document.getElementById('tab-items').innerHTML=html;
}

function describeEffects(eff){
  return Object.entries(eff).map(([k,v])=>`${k}:${v}`).join(', ');
}

function renderData(){
  const eqRows=Object.entries(EQUIPMENT).map(([k,e])=>[
    `<span class="pill ${e.slot}">${e.name}</span>`, e.slot, e.removable?'yes':'no', e.fame, e.minHull, e.cost, describeEffects(e.effects), e.tags.join(', ')
  ]);
  const shipRows=Object.entries(SHIPS).map(([k,s])=>[
    s.name, s.tier, s.maxHull, s.maxCrew, s.cannons, s.speed, s.maxDays, s.holdCapacity, SLOT_ORDER.map(sl=>`${sl}:${s.slots[sl]||0}`).join(' · ')
  ]);
  let html='<div class="panel"><h2>Data Used by This Tool</h2>';
  html+='<h3>Ships</h3>'+tableScroll(['Ship','Tier','Hull','Crew','Cannons','Speed','Days','Hold','Slots'], shipRows);
  html+='<h3>Equipment</h3>'+tableScroll(['Item','Slot','Removable','Fame','Min Hull','Cost','Effects','Tags'], eqRows);
  html+='<h3>Implementation Notes</h3><pre>'+
`Storm Rigging: prevents storm hull damage only. It does NOT prevent crew loss from storm events.\n`+
`Tar-Sealed Hull: now protects against calm winds / doldrums effects, gives +2 maxDays, and has -1 speed.\n`+
`War Pennants: +1 fame only on hunt/combat, patrol, and assault mission victories. Not starter, trade, smuggle, escort, or random fights. Heat from those victories is doubled.\n`+
`Ship sale rule: removable equipment should be unmounted before selling; do not silently move it to inventory. Structural equipment is always lost with the ship.\n`+
`Old saves: old upgrades are discarded, not migrated.\n`+
`Cargo hold revamp: Fluyt 1500, Merchantman 700, Galleon 1000, Ship of the Line 900.`+
'</pre>';
  html+='</div>';
  document.getElementById('tab-data').innerHTML=html;
}

runAnalysis();
</script>

</html>

{"id":"game-feel","cat":"Systems Design","icon":"✨","title":"Game Feel & Juice","tag":"Why pressing the button feels good","c30s":{"h":"Game feel is the reason players say a game 'feels good' without being able to explain why.","b":"It's the weight of Mario's jump, the snap of a Candy Crush cascade, the satisfying 'strike!' in Wii Sports bowling. Juice isn't information — it's emotion. It transforms correct mechanics into compelling experiences."],["Input Latency","At 60fps, one frame = 16ms. Players feel lag above ~50ms. const CATEGORIES = [];
const catMap = {};
TOPICS_RAW.forEach(t => {
  if (!catMap[t.cat]) { catMap[t.cat] = []; CATEGORIES.push({name:t.cat, topics:catMap[t.cat]}); }
  catMap[t.cat].push(t);
});
const allTopics = TOPICS_RAW;
const find = id => allTopics.find(t=>t.id===id) || allTopics[0];
const flatIds = allTopics.map(t=>t.id);

let curId = flatIds[0], curDepth = '30s';

function setDepth(d){curDepth=d;render()}
function setTopic(id){curId=id;render();closeMobile()}
function prevTopic(){const i=flatIds.indexOf(curId);if(i>0)setTopic(flatIds[i-1])}
function nextTopic(){const i=flatIds.indexOf(curId);if(i<flatIds.length-1)setTopic(flatIds[i+1])}

function render(){
  renderSidebar();renderDepth();renderMain();renderMobileBtn();
}

function renderSidebar(){
  const sb=document.getElementById('sidebar');
  let h='';
  CATEGORIES.forEach(c=>{
    h+=`<div class="sidebar-cat">${c.name}</div>`;
    c.topics.forEach(t=>{
      h+=`<div class="sidebar-item ${t.id===curId?'active':''}" onclick="setTopic('${t.id}')"><span class="icon">${t.icon}</span><div><span class="label">${t.title}</span><span class="tag">${t.tag}</span></div></div>`;
    });
  });
  sb.innerHTML=h;
}

function renderDepth(){
  const ds=document.getElementById('depthSelector');
  ds.innerHTML=['30s','3m','30m'].map(d=>{
    const active=curDepth===d?`active-${d}`:'';
    const labels={'30s':'⚡ 30s','3m':'📖 3 min','30m':'🔭 30 min'};
    return `<button class="depth-btn ${active}" onclick="setDepth('${d}')">${labels[d]}</button>`;
  }).join('');
}

function renderMain(){
  const t=find(curId);
  const idx=flatIds.indexOf(curId);
  let h=`<div class="topic-header"><div class="topic-icon">${t.icon}</div><h1 class="topic-title">${t.title}</h1><p class="topic-tag">${t.tag}</p></div>`;
  if(curDepth==='30s') h+=r30s(t.c30s);
  else if(curDepth==='3m') h+=r3m(t.c3m);
  else h+=r30m(t.c30m);
  h+=`<div class="bottom-nav"><button class="nav-btn" onclick="prevTopic()" ${idx===0?'disabled':''}>← Previous</button><button class="nav-btn" onclick="nextTopic()" ${idx===flatIds.length-1?'disabled':''}>Next →</button></div>`;
  document.getElementById('mainContent').innerHTML=h;
}

function r30s(d){
  return `<div class="content-30s"><div class="headline-30s">${d.h}</div><p class="context-30s">${d.b}</p></div>`;
}

function r3m(d){
  let h='<div class="content-3m">';
  if(d.intro) h+=`<p class="intro-3m">${d.intro}</p>`;
  d.sec.forEach(s=>{
    h+=`<div class="section-3m"><h3>${s[0]}</h3><p>${s[1]}</p></div>`;
  });
  if(d.ex) h+=`<div class="example-box"><div class="elabel">💡 Example</div><p>${d.ex}</p></div>`;
  if(d.try) h+=`<div class="try-this"><div class="elabel">✦ Try This</div><p>${d.try}</p></div>`;
  h+='</div>';
  return h;
}

function r30m(d){
  let h='<div class="content-30m">';
  if(d.insight) h+=`<div class="key-insight">"${d.insight}"</div>`;
  if(d.intro) h+=`<p class="intro-30m">${d.intro}</p>`;
  d.sec.forEach(s=>{
    h+=`<div class="section-30m"><h3>${s[0]}</h3><div class="body">${s[1]}</div></div>`;
  });
  if(d.takeaway) h+=`<div class="takeaway-box"><div class="elabel">⊞ Key Takeaway</div><p>${d.takeaway}</p></div>`;
  if(d.tip) h+=`<div class="practical-tip"><h3>🛠 Practical Exercise</h3><p>${d.tip}</p></div>`;
  h+='</div>';
  return h;
}

function renderMobileBtn(){
  const t=find(curId);
  document.getElementById('mobileBtnIcon').textContent=t.icon;
  document.getElementById('mobileBtnTitle').textContent=t.title;
}

document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const dd=document.getElementById('mobileDropdown');
  if(dd.classList.contains('show')){closeMobile();return;}
  let h='';
  CATEGORIES.forEach(c=>{
    h+=`<div class="sidebar-cat">${c.name}</div>`;
    c.topics.forEach(t=>{
      h+=`<div class="sidebar-item ${t.id===curId?'active':''}" onclick="setTopic('${t.id}')"><span class="icon">${t.icon}</span><div><span class="label">${t.title}</span><span class="tag">${t.tag}</span></div></div>`;
    });
  });
  dd.innerHTML=h;dd.classList.add('show');
});

function closeMobile(){document.getElementById('mobileDropdown').classList.remove('show')}
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  <div id="root"></div>

  <script type="text/babel">
    const { useState, useEffect } = React;
    const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root"));

    function App() {
      const [icons, setIcons] = useState([]);

      useEffect(() => {
        if (!window.UI) return;
        // Grab all functions whose name starts with 'Icon'
        const iconEntries = Object.entries(window.UI)
          .filter(([key, val]) => key.startsWith("Icon") && typeof val === "function")
          .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
        setIcons(iconEntries);
      }, []);

      if (icons.length === 0) {
        return <div style={{ color: "#b0a48c", textAlign: "center", marginTop: 40 }}>
          Loading icons… (ensure ui.jsx is properly loaded)
        </div>;
      }

      return (
        <div className="grid">
          {icons.map(([name, IconComponent]) => (
            <div key={name} className="card">
              {/* Render the icon at 50x50 with the game's gold color */}
              <IconComponent size={50} color="#c9aa6e" />
              <div className="label">{name}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      );
    }

    root.render(<App />);
  </script>
</body>

  <div class="notes">
    <h3>What changed in v4</h3>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>City reverted to v1-style organic layout</strong> with irregular vertical positions and varied sizes, but with ~15 more buildings filling the gaps for density.</li>
      <li><strong>Render order strictly top-down</strong>: cathedral and summit cluster first, then upper hill, then mid hill, then lower hill. Each tier covers the bases of buildings above.</li>
      <li><strong>Single brown tone (#3a2818) for ALL buildings</strong> including cathedral, bell tower, fortress, ramparts. No more darker tone for summit buildings.</li>
      <li><strong>Steeper rampart slope</strong>: sections now rise from y=240 at fortress to y=185 at the top of section 2 - aggressive upward climb instead of the previous gentle angle.</li>
      <li><strong>Floating summit buildings removed</strong>: the right-of-cathedral cluster that was floating in space is gone.</li>
      <li><strong>Jungle kept as-is</strong> per feedback.</li>
    </ul>

    <h3>Final assessment questions</h3>
    <ul>
      <li>Does the city layout finally feel organic rather than grid-aligned?</li>
      <li>Do the steeper ramparts read as walls climbing the hill?</li>
      <li>Is the cathedral still the focal point even with unified building tone?</li>
      <li>Anything else needed before we apply this template to the other 4 factions?</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function exportScene(id, fn) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!el) return;

  // Wait for all images inside this element to be complete
  const imgs = el.querySelectorAll('img');
  const wait = Promise.all(Array.from(imgs).map(img => {
    if (img.complete) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      img.onload = resolve;
      img.onerror = resolve; // don't block on error
    });
  }));

  wait.then(() => {
    html2canvas(el, {
      backgroundColor: null,
      scale: 2,
      useCORS: true,
      allowTaint: false,   // safer for toDataURL
    }).then(c => {
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.download = fn;
      a.href = c.toDataURL("image/png");
      a.click();
    }).catch(err => console.error("Export failed:", err));
  });
}
</script>

function waitReady(cb, attempt) {
  attempt = attempt || 0;
  const ready = window.UI && window.UI.T && window.UI.Btn && window.UI.LogList
             && window.D && window.D.FACTIONS && window.D.SHIP_VISUALS
             && window.L && window.L.classifyLogLine;
  if (ready) cb();
  else if (attempt < 80) setTimeout(() => waitReady(cb, attempt + 1), 100);
  else document.getElementById('scenes-root').innerHTML =
    '<div class="loading" style="color:#d06a58">Failed to load game UI. Verify ../data.js, ../ui.jsx, ../icons.jsx, ../logic.js, ../ship-sprite.js all exist and load successfully.</div>';
}

<script>
(function () {
  // ── Display order (matches the tiers from data) ────────────
  const SHIP_ORDER = [
    { key: "dinghy",            tier: "Tier 0 — Starter" },
    { key: "cutter",            tier: "Tier 0 — Starter" },
    { key: "sloop",             tier: "Tier 1 — First real ship" },
    { key: "schooner",          tier: "Tier 2 — Specialization" },
    { key: "merchantman",       tier: "Tier 2 — Specialization" },
    { key: "brigantine",        tier: "Tier 2 — Specialization" },
    { key: "corvette",          tier: "Tier 3 — Warship" },
    { key: "frigate",           tier: "Tier 3 — Warship" },
    { key: "fluyt",             tier: "Tier 3 — Warship" },
    { key: "galleon",           tier: "Tier 4 — Endgame" },
    { key: "ship_of_the_line",  tier: "Tier 4 — Endgame" },
  ];

  // ── Current state of controls ──────────────────────────────
  const state = {
    faction: "none",          // "none" or faction key
    facing: "left",
    equipment: new Set(),
  };

  // ── Wait for data.js + ship-sprite.js to load ─────────────
  function waitForReady(attempt) {
    attempt = attempt || 0;
    const ready = window.D && window.D.SHIP_VISUALS && window.ShipSprite && window.ShipSprite.render;
    if (ready) {
      initControls();
      renderAll();
    } else if (attempt > 50) {
      const grid = document.getElementById("grid");
      grid.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Failed to load ../data.js or ../ship-sprite.js. Make sure SHIP_VISUALS is defined in data.js and the file paths are correct.</div>';
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => waitForReady(attempt + 1), 100);
    }
  }

  // ── Wire up control buttons ────────────────────────────────
  function initControls() {
    document.querySelectorAll("#factionRow .btn").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        document.querySelectorAll("#factionRow .btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
        btn.classList.add("active");
        state.faction = btn.dataset.faction;
        renderAll();
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("#facingRow .btn").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        document.querySelectorAll("#facingRow .btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
        btn.classList.add("active");
        state.facing = btn.dataset.facing;
        renderAll();
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("#equipmentRow input[type=checkbox]").forEach(cb => {
      cb.addEventListener("change", () => {
        if (cb.checked) state.equipment.add(cb.dataset.equip);
        else state.equipment.delete(cb.dataset.equip);
        renderAll();
      });
    });

    document.getElementById("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      // Reset state
      state.faction = "none";
      state.facing = "left";
      state.equipment.clear();
      // Reset UI
      document.querySelectorAll("#factionRow .btn").forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.faction === "none");
      });
      document.querySelectorAll("#facingRow .btn").forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.facing === "left");
      });
      document.querySelectorAll("#equipmentRow input[type=checkbox]").forEach(cb => {
        cb.checked = false;
      });
      renderAll();
    });
  }

  // ── Build a single ship card ───────────────────────────────
  function buildCard(shipKey, tier) {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "ship-card";

    const config = window.D.SHIP_VISUALS[shipKey];
    if (!config) {
      card.innerHTML = `
        <h2 class="ship-name">${shipKey}</h2>
        <div class="error">No SHIP_VISUALS config found for "${shipKey}"</div>
      `;
      return card;
    }

    // Name
    const name = document.createElement("h2");
    name.className = "ship-name";
    name.textContent = shipKey.replace(/_/g, " ");
    card.appendChild(name);

    // Tier subtitle
    const tierDiv = document.createElement("div");
    tierDiv.className = "ship-tier";
    tierDiv.textContent = tier;
    card.appendChild(tierDiv);

    // Sprite
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sprite-wrap";
    card.appendChild(wrap);

    try {
      const svg = window.ShipSprite.render(shipKey, {
        faction: state.faction === "none" ? null : state.faction,
        equipment: Array.from(state.equipment),
        width: 400,
        height: 280,
        facing: state.facing,
        showFlag: state.faction !== "none",
      });
      if (svg) {
        wrap.appendChild(svg);
      } else {
        wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Renderer returned null</div>';
      }
    } catch (err) {
      wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Render error: ' + (err.message || err) + '</div>';
    }

    // Config block
    const cfgBlock = document.createElement("div");
    cfgBlock.className = "config-block";
    cfgBlock.innerHTML = buildConfigSummary(shipKey, config);
    card.appendChild(cfgBlock);

    return card;
  }

  // ── Build a human-readable config summary ──────────────────
  function buildConfigSummary(shipKey, config) {
    const lines = [];
    lines.push(`<strong>shape:</strong> ${config.hullShape} &nbsp; <strong>length:</strong> ${config.hullLength} &nbsp; <strong>height:</strong> ${config.hullHeight}`);

    const decks = [];
    if (config.hasForecastle) decks.push("forecastle");
    if (config.hasQuarterdeck) decks.push("quarterdeck");
    if (config.hasPoopDeck) decks.push("poop");
    if (config.hasSternGallery) decks.push("stern gallery");
    if (decks.length) {
      lines.push(`<strong>decks:</strong> ${decks.join(", ")}`);
    }

    const mastDesc = config.masts.map((m, i) => {
      const sails = m.sails ? Object.keys(m.sails).filter(k => m.sails[k]).join("+") : "—";
      return `${i+1}. ${m.rig} [${sails || "—"}]`;
    }).join(" · ");
    lines.push(`<strong>masts (${config.masts.length}):</strong> ${mastDesc}`);

    lines.push(`<strong>guns:</strong> ${config.gunDecks} deck${config.gunDecks === 1 ? "" : "s"}, ${config.gunPortsLower || 0}${config.gunPortsUpper ? " + " + config.gunPortsUpper : ""} ports`);
    lines.push(`<strong>bowsprit:</strong> ${config.bowsprit}`);
    if (config.staysails) {
      lines.push(`<strong>staysails:</strong> ${config.staysails.join(", ")}`);
    }
    return lines.join("<br/>");
  }

  // ── Render all ships ───────────────────────────────────────
  function renderAll() {
    const grid = document.getElementById("grid");
    grid.innerHTML = "";

    SHIP_ORDER.forEach(({ key, tier }) => {
      grid.appendChild(buildCard(key, tier));
    });
  }

  // ── Bootstrap ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  window.addEventListener("load", () => waitForReady(0));
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
// ---- error capture (shown on-screen so mobile can see it) ----
window.onerror = function(msg, src, line, col, err) {
  var panel = document.getElementById('debug-panel');
  if (panel) {
    panel.style.display = 'block';
    panel.innerHTML = '<strong>JS Error</strong><br>' + msg + '<br>line ' + line;
  }
  return false;
};

// ---- registry & helpers ----
var registry = [];
var active   = {};

function registerSound(def) {
  registry.push(def);
}

function noiseBuffer(ctx, sec) {
  var n   = Math.ceil(ctx.sampleRate * sec);
  var buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, n, ctx.sampleRate);
  var d   = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
  }
  return buf;
}

// Procedural impulse response for ConvolverNode.
// type: 'room' (smooth decay) | 'metal' (shimmering) | 'outdoor' (long tail)
function makeImpulse(ctx, durationSec, decay, type) {
  type = type || 'room';
  var rate = ctx.sampleRate;
  var len  = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rate * durationSec));
  var buf  = ctx.createBuffer(2, len, rate);
  for (var ch = 0; ch < 2; ch++) {
    var d = buf.getChannelData(ch);
    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      var n   = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      var env = Math.pow(1 - i / len, decay);
      if (type === 'metal') env *= 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(i * 0.03);
      d[i] = n * env;
    }
  }
  return buf;
}

function getCtx() {
  var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
  if (!AC) throw new Error('Web Audio API not supported on this browser.');
  return new AC();
}

// -- Bell -----------------------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'bell', icon: '&#x1F514;', name: 'Ship Bell',
  desc: 'Two deep iron strikes echoing across still water',
  loop: false, durationSec: 5,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var f0 = 270;
    var partials = [
      [1.000, 1.00], [2.765, 0.42], [5.409, 0.22],
      [8.920, 0.11], [13.34, 0.06], [18.64, 0.03]
    ];
    var master = ctx.createGain();
    master.gain.value = 0.38;
    master.connect(ctx.destination);

    function strike(offset, ampMul) {
      var startAt = ctx.currentTime + offset;
      var dur = 4.5;
      for (var i = 0; i < partials.length; i++) {
        var ratio = partials[i][0];
        var amp   = partials[i][1] * ampMul;
        var osc   = ctx.createOscillator();
        var g     = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.value = f0 * ratio;
        var decay = Math.min(dur * 0.95, dur / (ratio * 0.38 + 0.62));
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(amp, startAt);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, startAt + decay);
        osc.connect(g); g.connect(master);
        osc.start(startAt); osc.stop(startAt + dur);
      }
      // hammer click
      var click = ctx.createBufferSource();
      click.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.025);
      var cf = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      cf.type = 'bandpass'; cf.frequency.value = 600; cf.Q.value = 1;
      var cg = ctx.createGain();
      cg.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3 * ampMul, startAt);
      cg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startAt + 0.025);
      click.connect(cf); cf.connect(cg); cg.connect(master);
      click.start(startAt); click.stop(startAt + 0.03);
    }

    strike(0,    1.0);   // first dong
    strike(0.38, 0.78);  // second dong, slightly softer
  }
});

// -- Ocean Waves ----------------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'ocean', icon: '&#x1F30A;', name: 'Ocean Waves',
  desc: 'Rolling sea swells — 30s noise loop, slow drifting filters',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 30);  // <-- was 6
    src.loop   = true;

    var hpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    hpf.type = 'highpass'; hpf.frequency.value = 80;

    var lpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    lpf.type = 'lowpass'; lpf.frequency.value = 750; lpf.Q.value = 0.8;

    // Three incommensurate LFOs on filter cutoff — long perceived period
    var lfo1 = ctx.createOscillator(); var lg1 = ctx.createGain();
    lfo1.frequency.value = 0.13; lg1.gain.value = 380;
    lfo1.connect(lg1); lg1.connect(lpf.frequency);

    var lfo2 = ctx.createOscillator(); var lg2 = ctx.createGain();
    lfo2.frequency.value = 0.237; lg2.gain.value = 160;
    lfo2.connect(lg2); lg2.connect(lpf.frequency);

    var lfo3 = ctx.createOscillator(); var lg3 = ctx.createGain();
    lfo3.frequency.value = 0.041; lg3.gain.value = 220; // very slow drift
    lfo3.connect(lg3); lg3.connect(lpf.frequency);

    // Slow volume swell
    var vLfo = ctx.createOscillator(); var vLg = ctx.createGain();
    vLfo.frequency.value = 0.19; vLg.gain.value = 0.12;
    vLfo.connect(vLg);

    var master = ctx.createGain();
    master.gain.value = 0.38;
    vLg.connect(master.gain);

    src.connect(hpf); hpf.connect(lpf); lpf.connect(master);
    master.connect(ctx.destination);

    src.start(); lfo1.start(); lfo2.start(); lfo3.start(); vLfo.start();

    return function() {
      try { src.stop();  } catch(e) {}
      try { lfo1.stop(); } catch(e) {}
      try { lfo2.stop(); } catch(e) {}
      try { lfo3.stop(); } catch(e) {}
      try { vLfo.stop(); } catch(e) {}
    };
  }
});

// -- Gunshot --------------------------------------------------

 registerSound({
  id: 'gunshot', icon: '&#x1F52B;', name: 'Gunshot',
  desc: 'A flintlock crack with a black-powder boom and outdoor tail',
  loop: false, durationSec: 2.5,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var t0 = ctx.currentTime;
    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.55;

    // --- outdoor reverb (convolver) ---
    var conv = ctx.createConvolver();
    conv.buffer = makeImpulse(ctx, 1.8, 2.5, 'outdoor');
    var wet = ctx.createGain(); wet.gain.value = 0.35;
    var dry = ctx.createGain(); dry.gain.value = 0.85;
    master.connect(dry); dry.connect(ctx.destination);
    master.connect(conv); conv.connect(wet); wet.connect(ctx.destination);

    // (1) ignition click — 8 ms, high-Q resonance
    var click = ctx.createBufferSource();
    click.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.008);
    var clickF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    clickF.type = 'bandpass'; clickF.frequency.value = 5000; clickF.Q.value = 12;
    var clickG = ctx.createGain();
    clickG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.35, t0);
    clickG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.008);
    click.connect(clickF); clickF.connect(clickG); clickG.connect(master);
    click.start(t0); click.stop(t0 + 0.01);

    // (2) main CRACK — high-Q bandpass at 2.5 kHz
    var crack = ctx.createBufferSource();
    crack.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.1);
    var crackF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    crackF.type = 'bandpass'; crackF.frequency.value = 2500; crackF.Q.value = 10;
    var crackG = ctx.createGain();
    crackG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t0 + 0.005);
    crackG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(1.4, t0 + 0.008);
    crackG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.09);
    crack.connect(crackF); crackF.connect(crackG); crackG.connect(master);
    crack.start(t0 + 0.005); crack.stop(t0 + 0.11);

    // (2b) parallel SNAP — highpass noise for the air whip
    var snap = ctx.createBufferSource();
    snap.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.04);
    var snapF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    snapF.type = 'highpass'; snapF.frequency.value = 4000;
    var snapG = ctx.createGain();
    snapG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.8, t0 + 0.005);
    snapG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.045);
    snap.connect(snapF); snapF.connect(snapG); snapG.connect(master);
    snap.start(t0 + 0.005); snap.stop(t0 + 0.05);

    // (3) BOOM — lowpass-swept noise body
    var boom = ctx.createBufferSource();
    boom.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.5);
    var boomF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    boomF.type = 'lowpass';
    boomF.frequency.setValueAtTime(800, t0 + 0.005);
    boomF.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(60, t0 + 0.4);
    var boomG = ctx.createGain();
    boomG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.9, t0 + 0.005);
    boomG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.45);
    boom.connect(boomF); boomF.connect(boomG); boomG.connect(master);
    boom.start(t0 + 0.005); boom.stop(t0 + 0.5);

    // (4) SUB thump — pitch drops from 80 → 30 Hz
    var sub = ctx.createOscillator(); sub.type = 'sine';
    sub.frequency.setValueAtTime(80, t0 + 0.005);
    sub.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(30, t0 + 0.35);
    var subG = ctx.createGain();
    subG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.7, t0 + 0.005);
    subG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.4);
    sub.connect(subG); subG.connect(master);
    sub.start(t0 + 0.005); sub.stop(t0 + 0.42);
  }
});

// -- Sword Clang ----------------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'sword', icon: '&#x2694;', name: 'Sword Clang',
  desc: 'Steel on steel — inharmonic ring with metallic shimmer',
  loop: false, durationSec: 2.5,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var t0 = ctx.currentTime;
    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.5;

    // --- small metallic reverb ---
    var conv = ctx.createConvolver();
    conv.buffer = makeImpulse(ctx, 0.6, 3, 'metal');
    var wet = ctx.createGain(); wet.gain.value = 0.28;
    var dry = ctx.createGain(); dry.gain.value = 0.9;
    master.connect(dry); dry.connect(ctx.destination);
    master.connect(conv); conv.connect(wet); wet.connect(ctx.destination);

    // (1) scrape transient — high-shelf noise burst
    var scrape = ctx.createBufferSource();
    scrape.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.04);
    var scrapeF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    scrapeF.type = 'highpass'; scrapeF.frequency.value = 3000;
    var scrapeG = ctx.createGain();
    scrapeG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.7, t0);
    scrapeG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.04);
    scrape.connect(scrapeF); scrapeF.connect(scrapeG); scrapeG.connect(master);
    scrape.start(t0); scrape.stop(t0 + 0.05);

    // (2) INHARMONIC partials — deliberately non-musical ratios
    // freq, decay-seconds, amplitude
    var partials = [
      [1840, 1.8, 1.00],
      [2730, 1.4, 0.70],
      [4120, 1.0, 0.50],
      [5680, 0.7, 0.32],
      [7200, 0.45, 0.20],
      [9100, 0.30, 0.12]
    ];

    // Shared ring-mod carrier — adds metallic sidebands
    var ringMod = ctx.createOscillator();
    ringMod.frequency.value = 73; // inharmonic w.r.t. partials
    ringMod.start(t0); ringMod.stop(t0 + 2.2);

    for (var i = 0; i < partials.length; i++) {
      var freq = partials[i][0], decay = partials[i][1], amp = partials[i][2];

      var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = freq;
      osc.detune.value = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14; // ±7 cents

      // Ring modulation: gain.value=0 + modulator -> .gain  ===  carrier * modulator
      var ringGate = ctx.createGain(); ringGate.gain.value = 0;
      var ringDepth = ctx.createGain(); ringDepth.gain.value = 0.35;
      ringMod.connect(ringDepth); ringDepth.connect(ringGate.gain);

      // Mix: 65% dry partial + 35% ring-modulated
      var dryMix = ctx.createGain(); dryMix.gain.value = 0.65;
      var partialEnv = ctx.createGain();
      partialEnv.gain.setValueAtTime(amp * 0.45, t0);
      partialEnv.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + decay);

      osc.connect(dryMix);    dryMix.connect(partialEnv);
      osc.connect(ringGate);  ringGate.connect(partialEnv);
      partialEnv.connect(master);

      osc.start(t0); osc.stop(t0 + decay + 0.05);
    }
  }
});

// -- Tavern Crowd ---------------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'crowd', icon: '&#x1F37A;', name: 'Tavern Crowd',
  desc: 'A rowdy tavern — babble streams, mug clinks, laughter',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var stops = [];
    var timers = [];
    var alive = true;

    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.45;
    var roomLP = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    roomLP.type = 'lowpass'; roomLP.frequency.value = 3800;
    roomLP.connect(master); master.connect(ctx.destination);

    // --- 5 babble streams, each with random slow amplitude modulation ---
    var formants = [600, 900, 1200, 1800, 2400];

    function makeModBuffer(sec, rateHz) {
      var len = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * sec);
      var buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate);
      var d = buf.getChannelData(0);
      var step = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate / rateHz);
      var prev = Math.random() * 0.7, next = Math.random() * 0.7, idx = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        if (idx >= step) { prev = next; next = Math.random() * 0.7; idx = 0; }
        d[i] = prev + (next - prev) * (idx / step); // linear interp
        idx++;
      }
      return buf;
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < formants.length; i++) {
      var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
      src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 4);
      src.loop = true;

      var bp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      bp.type = 'bandpass'; bp.frequency.value = formants[i]; bp.Q.value = 4;

      var modSrc = ctx.createBufferSource();
      modSrc.buffer = makeModBuffer(8, 1.5 + Math.random() * 2); // 1.5–3.5 Hz
      modSrc.loop = true;

      var streamG = ctx.createGain(); streamG.gain.value = 0;
      modSrc.connect(streamG.gain);

      src.connect(bp); bp.connect(streamG); streamG.connect(roomLP);
      src.start(); modSrc.start();

      (function(s, m) {
        stops.push(function() {
          try { s.stop(); } catch(e) {}
          try { m.stop(); } catch(e) {}
        });
      })(src, modSrc);
    }

    // --- random clink layer ---
    function scheduleClink() {
      if (!alive) return;
      var when = ctx.currentTime + 0.05;
      var f1 = ctx.createOscillator(); f1.type = 'sine';
      f1.frequency.value = 2400 + Math.random() * 600;
      var f2 = ctx.createOscillator(); f2.type = 'sine';
      f2.frequency.value = 3700 + Math.random() * 700;
      var g = ctx.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18, when + 0.005);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + 0.18);
      f1.connect(g); f2.connect(g); g.connect(roomLP);
      f1.start(when); f2.start(when);
      f1.stop(when + 0.2); f2.stop(when + 0.2);
      timers.push(setTimeout(scheduleClink, 1500 + Math.random() * 2800));
    }

    // --- random laugh / shout bursts (formant-AM'd noise) ---
    function scheduleLaugh() {
      if (!alive) return;
      var when = ctx.currentTime + 0.05;
      var dur = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.35;
      var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
      src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, dur);
      var bp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      bp.type = 'bandpass';
      bp.frequency.value = 700 + Math.random() * 500;
      bp.Q.value = 6;
      var am = ctx.createOscillator();
      am.frequency.value = 4 + Math.random() * 4; // "ha-ha-ha" rate
      var amDepth = ctx.createGain(); amDepth.gain.value = 0.12;
      am.connect(amDepth);
      var g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.13;
      amDepth.connect(g.gain);
      src.connect(bp); bp.connect(g); g.connect(roomLP);
      src.start(when); am.start(when);
      src.stop(when + dur); am.stop(when + dur);
      timers.push(setTimeout(scheduleLaugh, 2500 + Math.random() * 4500));
    }

    timers.push(setTimeout(scheduleClink, 800));
    timers.push(setTimeout(scheduleLaugh, 1800));

    return function() {
      alive = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < timers.length; i++) clearTimeout(timers[i]);
      for (var j = 0; j < stops.length; j++) stops[j]();
    };
  }
});

// -- Splash ---------------------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'splash', icon: '&#x1F4A7;', name: 'Splash',
  desc: 'Body hits water — sharp impact, chaotic bubble cluster',
  loop: false, durationSec: 2,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var t0 = ctx.currentTime;
    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.65;
    master.connect(ctx.destination);

    // (1) sharp impact
    var imp = ctx.createBufferSource();
    imp.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.03);
    var impF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    impF.type = 'bandpass'; impF.frequency.value = 1200; impF.Q.value = 3;
    var impG = ctx.createGain();
    impG.gain.setValueAtTime(1.0, t0);
    impG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.03);
    imp.connect(impF); impF.connect(impG); impG.connect(master);
    imp.start(t0); imp.stop(t0 + 0.04);

    // (2) water body — filter sweep from bright to muffled
    var water = ctx.createBufferSource();
    water.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 1.2);
    var hpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    hpf.type = 'highpass'; hpf.frequency.value = 200;
    var lpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lpf.type = 'lowpass';
    lpf.frequency.setValueAtTime(5000, t0);
    lpf.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(300, t0 + 1.0);
    var waterG = ctx.createGain();
    waterG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.6, t0);
    waterG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 1.2);
    water.connect(hpf); hpf.connect(lpf); lpf.connect(waterG); waterG.connect(master);
    water.start(t0); water.stop(t0 + 1.3);

    // (3) RANDOMIZED bubble cluster — 14 sine chirps, rising pitch
    for (var i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      var when   = t0 + 0.03 + Math.random() * 0.8;
      var startF = 300 + Math.random() * 1200;
      var endF   = startF * (1.3 + Math.random() * 0.4); // bubbles rise in pitch
      var dur    = 0.06 + Math.random() * 0.08;
      var amp    = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.14;

      var osc = ctx.createOscillator(); osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(startF, when);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endF, when + dur);
      var bg = ctx.createGain();
      bg.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      bg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(amp, when + 0.005);
      bg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + dur);
      osc.connect(bg); bg.connect(master);
      osc.start(when); osc.stop(when + dur + 0.02);
    }
  }
});


// -- Cannon ---------------------------------------------------


registerSound({
  id: 'cannon', icon: '&#x1F4A5;', name: 'Cannon Fire',
  desc: 'Massive black-powder cannon — ignition, boom, rolling thunder',
  loop: false, durationSec: 4.5,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var t0 = ctx.currentTime;
    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.6;

    // --- big outdoor naval reverb ---
    var conv = ctx.createConvolver();
    conv.buffer = makeImpulse(ctx, 3, 2, 'outdoor');
    var wet = ctx.createGain(); wet.gain.value = 0.45;
    var dry = ctx.createGain(); dry.gain.value = 0.9;
    master.connect(dry); dry.connect(ctx.destination);
    master.connect(conv); conv.connect(wet); wet.connect(ctx.destination);

    // (1) powder ignition fizz (just before the boom)
    var fizz = ctx.createBufferSource();
    fizz.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.025);
    var fizzF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    fizzF.type = 'highpass'; fizzF.frequency.value = 3000;
    var fizzG = ctx.createGain();
    fizzG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.4, t0);
    fizzG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.025);
    fizz.connect(fizzF); fizzF.connect(fizzG); fizzG.connect(master);
    fizz.start(t0); fizz.stop(t0 + 0.03);

    // (2) mid-range punch — the "crack" of the muzzle
    var crack = ctx.createBufferSource();
    crack.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.15);
    var crackF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    crackF.type = 'bandpass'; crackF.frequency.value = 1200; crackF.Q.value = 6;
    var crackG = ctx.createGain();
    crackG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t0 + 0.02);
    crackG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(1.5, t0 + 0.025);
    crackG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.15);
    crack.connect(crackF); crackF.connect(crackG); crackG.connect(master);
    crack.start(t0 + 0.02); crack.stop(t0 + 0.16);

    // (3) BOOM body — long lowpass-swept noise
    var boom = ctx.createBufferSource();
    boom.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 1.5);
    var boomF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    boomF.type = 'lowpass';
    boomF.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, t0 + 0.02);
    boomF.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(50, t0 + 1.2);
    var boomG = ctx.createGain();
    boomG.gain.setValueAtTime(1.2, t0 + 0.02);
    boomG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 1.3);
    boom.connect(boomF); boomF.connect(boomG); boomG.connect(master);
    boom.start(t0 + 0.02); boom.stop(t0 + 1.4);

    // (4) deep SUB — chest-thumping fundamental drops 55 → 22 Hz
    var sub = ctx.createOscillator(); sub.type = 'sine';
    sub.frequency.setValueAtTime(55, t0 + 0.02);
    sub.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(22, t0 + 0.9);
    var subG = ctx.createGain();
    subG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t0 + 0.02);
    subG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(1.0, t0 + 0.04);
    subG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 1.0);
    sub.connect(subG); subG.connect(master);
    sub.start(t0 + 0.02); sub.stop(t0 + 1.05);

    // (5) rolling thunder echoes across the bay
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      var when = t0 + 0.4 + i * 0.28 + Math.random() * 0.12;
      var rumble = ctx.createBufferSource();
      rumble.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.45);
      var rF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      rF.type = 'lowpass'; rF.frequency.value = 220 - i * 30;
      var rG = ctx.createGain();
      rG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      rG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.32 - i * 0.05, when + 0.06);
      rG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + 0.45);
      rumble.connect(rF); rF.connect(rG); rG.connect(master);
      rumble.start(when); rumble.stop(when + 0.48);
    }
  }
});




// ---------- Shanties ---------------------------------------------


registerSound({
  id: 'shanty', icon: '&#x1F3BB;', name: 'Pirate Shanty',
  desc: 'Fiddle, lute & flute — 19s loopable menu tune (D minor)',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var alive = true;
    var srcNode = null;
    var masterG = ctx.createGain();
    masterG.gain.value = 0.55;
    masterG.connect(ctx.destination);

    var tempo = 100;            // BPM
    var beat  = 60 / tempo;     // 0.6s per beat
    var bars  = 8;
    var totalDur = beat * 4 * bars + 0.5;  // 19.7s incl. tail
    var sr = ctx.sampleRate;

    var OAC = window.OfflineAudioContext || window.webkitOfflineAudioContext;
    var offline = new OAC(2, Math.ceil(sr * totalDur), sr);

    var N = {
      'A2': 110.00, 'D3': 146.83, 'F3': 174.61, 'G3': 196.00,
      'A3': 220.00, 'Bb3': 233.08, 'C4': 261.63, 'D4': 293.66,
      'E4': 329.63, 'F4': 349.23, 'G4': 392.00, 'A4': 440.00,
      'Bb4': 466.16, 'C5': 523.25, 'D5': 587.33, 'E5': 659.25, 'F5': 698.46
    };

    // --- FIDDLE: sawtooth + lowpass + vibrato, sustained bow ---
// --- FIDDLE v2: PeriodicWave + body formants + bow noise + delayed vibrato ---
function fiddle(when, freq, dur) {
  // Violin-like harmonic spectrum (H2 stronger than H1, gentle roll-off)
  var real = new Float32Array([0, 1.0, 1.15, 0.85, 0.65, 0.5, 0.4, 0.32, 0.26, 0.2, 0.14, 0.09, 0.06]);
  var imag = new Float32Array(real.length);
  var wave = offline.createPeriodicWave(real, imag);

  // Two oscillators slightly detuned — natural chorus
  var osc1 = offline.createOscillator();
  osc1.setPeriodicWave(wave); osc1.frequency.value = freq; osc1.detune.value = -5;
  var osc2 = offline.createOscillator();
  osc2.setPeriodicWave(wave); osc2.frequency.value = freq; osc2.detune.value = +5;

  // Subtle pitch instability at the very start ("bow grip")
  osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq * 0.996, when);
  osc1.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq, when + 0.09);
  osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq * 0.996, when);
  osc2.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq, when + 0.09);

  // Delayed vibrato — silent for first ~180ms, then ramps in
  var vibStart = Math.min(0.18, dur * 0.3);
  var vibFull  = Math.min(0.42, dur * 0.6);
  var vib  = offline.createOscillator(); vib.frequency.value = 5.2;
  var vibG = offline.createGain();
  vibG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
  vibG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when + vibStart);
  vibG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.013, when + vibFull);
  vib.connect(vibG);
  vibG.connect(osc1.frequency); vibG.connect(osc2.frequency);

  // --- Body resonance: parallel bandpass formants mimic violin wood ---
  var bodyMix = offline.createGain(); bodyMix.gain.value = 0.6;

  // Direct signal still passes through (otherwise it sounds hollow)
  var direct = offline.createGain(); direct.gain.value = 0.45;
  osc1.connect(direct); osc2.connect(direct); direct.connect(bodyMix);

  function formant(fHz, q, gain) {
    var bp = offline.createBiquadFilter();
    bp.type = 'bandpass'; bp.frequency.value = fHz; bp.Q.value = q;
    var g = offline.createGain(); g.gain.value = gain;
    osc1.connect(bp); osc2.connect(bp);
    bp.connect(g); g.connect(bodyMix);
  }
  formant(280,  3.5, 0.55);  // Helmholtz air resonance
  formant(460,  4.0, 0.65);  // top plate (T1)
  formant(2700, 1.8, 0.75);  // "bridge hill" — the violin's signature sparkle

  // --- Bow noise: filtered noise = friction character ---
  var nLen = Math.ceil(sr * dur);
  var nBuf = offline.createBuffer(1, nLen, sr);
  var nd = nBuf.getChannelData(0);
  for (var i = 0; i < nLen; i++) nd[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
  var bowNoise = offline.createBufferSource(); bowNoise.buffer = nBuf;
  var bowBP = offline.createBiquadFilter();
  bowBP.type = 'bandpass';
  bowBP.frequency.value = Math.min(freq * 5, 3800);
  bowBP.Q.value = 1.4;
  var bowG = offline.createGain();
  // Noise burst on attack, quiet sustain
  bowG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.14, when);
  bowG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.025, when + 0.12);
  bowG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.025, when + Math.max(dur - 0.08, 0.13));
  bowG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, when + dur);

  // --- Master envelope: slow bowed attack, gentle release ---
  var g = offline.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.13, when + 0.08);   // bowed attack (~80ms)
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.13, when + Math.max(dur - 0.1, 0.1));
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, when + dur);

  bowNoise.connect(bowBP); bowBP.connect(bowG); bowG.connect(g);
  bodyMix.connect(g);
  g.connect(offline.destination);

  osc1.start(when);     osc2.start(when);
  vib.start(when);      bowNoise.start(when);
  osc1.stop(when + dur);     osc2.stop(when + dur);
  vib.stop(when + dur);      bowNoise.stop(when + dur);
}

    // --- LUTE: plucked-string — saw+triangle, filter snaps down fast ---
    function lute(when, freq, dur) {
      var osc1 = offline.createOscillator();
      osc1.type = 'triangle'; osc1.frequency.value = freq;
      var osc2 = offline.createOscillator();
      osc2.type = 'sawtooth'; osc2.frequency.value = freq;
      var mix2 = offline.createGain(); mix2.gain.value = 0.35;
      var lpf = offline.createBiquadFilter();
      lpf.type = 'lowpass';
      lpf.frequency.setValueAtTime(4500, when);
      lpf.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(500, when + Math.min(dur * 0.6, 0.6));
      var g = offline.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.28, when + 0.005);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + dur);
      osc1.connect(lpf); osc2.connect(mix2); mix2.connect(lpf);
      lpf.connect(g); g.connect(offline.destination);
      osc1.start(when); osc2.start(when);
      osc1.stop(when + dur); osc2.stop(when + dur);
    }

    // --- FLUTE: sine + breath noise + vibrato ---
    function flute(when, freq, dur) {
      var osc = offline.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine'; osc.frequency.value = freq;
      var vib = offline.createOscillator(); var vibG = offline.createGain();
      vib.frequency.value = 5; vibG.gain.value = freq * 0.005;
      vib.connect(vibG); vibG.connect(osc.frequency);
      // breath noise
      var nLen = Math.ceil(sr * dur);
      var nBuf = offline.createBuffer(1, nLen, sr);
      var nd = nBuf.getChannelData(0);
      for (var i = 0; i < nLen; i++) nd[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1);
      var nSrc = offline.createBufferSource(); nSrc.buffer = nBuf;
      var nBP = offline.createBiquadFilter();
      nBP.type = 'bandpass'; nBP.frequency.value = freq * 2; nBP.Q.value = 6;
      var nG = offline.createGain(); nG.gain.value = 0.05;
      var g = offline.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18, when + 0.09);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, when + Math.max(dur - 0.12, 0.1));
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, when + dur);
      osc.connect(g); nSrc.connect(nBP); nBP.connect(nG); nG.connect(g);
      g.connect(offline.destination);
      osc.start(when); vib.start(when); nSrc.start(when);
      osc.stop(when + dur); vib.stop(when + dur); nSrc.stop(when + dur);
    }

    var INSTR = { fiddle: fiddle, lute: lute, flute: flute };

    // Score: [beat-index, note, beats-duration, instrument]
    // 8 bars * 4 beats = 32 beats. D minor (with B natural for that Dorian swagger).
    var score = [
      // ---- Bars 1-2: opening call (fiddle) ----
      [ 0,   'A4', 1,   'fiddle'],
      [ 1,   'A4', 1,   'fiddle'],
      [ 2,   'A4', 0.5, 'fiddle'],
      [ 2.5, 'D5', 1.5, 'fiddle'],
      [ 4,   'F5', 1,   'fiddle'],
      [ 5,   'E5', 1,   'fiddle'],
      [ 6,   'D5', 2,   'fiddle'],
      // ---- Bars 3-4: variation ----
      [ 8,   'A4', 1,   'fiddle'],
      [ 9,   'A4', 1,   'fiddle'],
      [10,   'A4', 0.5, 'fiddle'],
      [10.5, 'C5', 1.5, 'fiddle'],
      [12,   'D5', 1,   'fiddle'],
      [13,   'E5', 1,   'fiddle'],
      [14,   'D5', 2,   'fiddle'],
      // ---- Bars 5-6: flute takes the lead, descending ----
      [16,   'D5',  2, 'flute'],
      [18,   'C5',  2, 'flute'],
      [20,   'Bb4', 2, 'flute'],
      [22,   'A4',  2, 'flute'],
      // ---- Bars 7-8: fiddle resolution ----
      [24,   'G4',  1, 'fiddle'],
      [25,   'A4',  1, 'fiddle'],
      [26,   'Bb4', 1, 'fiddle'],
      [27,   'G4',  1, 'fiddle'],
      [28,   'A4',  3.5, 'fiddle'],

      // ---- LUTE bass line (every 2 beats) ----
      [ 0,  'D3', 2, 'lute'],
      [ 2,  'A2', 2, 'lute'],
      [ 4,  'D3', 2, 'lute'],
      [ 6,  'A2', 2, 'lute'],
      [ 8,  'D3', 2, 'lute'],
      [10,  'A2', 2, 'lute'],
      [12,  'F3', 2, 'lute'],
      [14,  'A2', 2, 'lute'],
      [16,  'D3', 2, 'lute'],
      [18,  'F3', 2, 'lute'],
      [20,  'G3', 2, 'lute'],
      [22,  'A3', 2, 'lute'],
      [24,  'D3', 2, 'lute'],
      [26,  'A2', 2, 'lute'],
      [28,  'D3', 4, 'lute']
    ];

    for (var i = 0; i < score.length; i++) {
      var s = score[i];
      var when = s[0] * beat;
      var freq = N[s[1]];
      var dur  = s[2] * beat * 0.95; // small gap between notes
      INSTR[s[3]](when, freq, dur);
    }

    // Render asynchronously, then loop the resulting buffer
    offline.startRendering().then(function(rendered) {
      if (!alive) return;
      srcNode = ctx.createBufferSource();
      // Loop ONLY the musical portion (drop the half-second tail padding)
      srcNode.buffer = rendered;
      srcNode.loop = true;
      srcNode.loopStart = 0;
      srcNode.loopEnd = beat * 4 * bars; // 19.2s
      srcNode.connect(masterG);
      srcNode.start();
    }).catch(function(err) {
      console.warn('Shanty render failed:', err);
    });

    return function() {
      alive = false;
      if (srcNode) { try { srcNode.stop(); } catch(e) {} }
    };
  }
});

registerSound({
  id: 'shanty_flute', icon: '&#x1F3B6;', name: 'Flute Shanty',
  desc: 'Two flutes + bass flute + drone + bodhrán — 42s loopable, D-minor',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var alive = true;
    var srcNode = null;
    var masterG = ctx.createGain();
    masterG.gain.value = 0.6;
    masterG.connect(ctx.destination);

    var tempo = 92;
    var beat  = 60 / tempo;
    var bars  = 16;
    var totalDur = beat * 4 * bars + 0.6;
    var sr = ctx.sampleRate;

    var OAC = window.OfflineAudioContext || window.webkitOfflineAudioContext;
    var offline = new OAC(2, Math.ceil(sr * totalDur), sr);

    var N = {
      'D3': 146.83, 'F3': 174.61, 'G3': 196.00, 'A3': 220.00,
      'Bb3': 233.08, 'C4': 261.63, 'D4': 293.66, 'E4': 329.63,
      'F4': 349.23, 'G4': 392.00, 'A4': 440.00, 'Bb4': 466.16,
      'C5': 523.25, 'D5': 587.33, 'E5': 659.25, 'F5': 698.46
    };

    // --- FLUTE (parameterizable for lead vs harmony) ---
    function flute(when, freq, dur, breathiness, detuneCents, ampMul) {
      var osc = offline.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = freq;
      osc.detune.value = detuneCents || 0;

      var vib = offline.createOscillator();
      var vibG = offline.createGain();
      vib.frequency.value = 4.8 + Math.random() * 0.5;
      vibG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      vibG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when + Math.min(0.12, dur * 0.25));
      vibG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.005, when + Math.min(0.32, dur * 0.55));
      vib.connect(vibG); vibG.connect(osc.frequency);

      var nLen = Math.ceil(sr * dur);
      var nBuf = offline.createBuffer(1, nLen, sr);
      var nd = nBuf.getChannelData(0);
      for (var i = 0; i < nLen; i++) nd[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      var nSrc = offline.createBufferSource(); nSrc.buffer = nBuf;
      var nBP = offline.createBiquadFilter();
      nBP.type = 'bandpass';
      nBP.frequency.value = freq * 2;
      nBP.Q.value = 5;
      var nG = offline.createGain();
      nG.gain.value = 0.05 * breathiness;

      var g = offline.createGain();
      var atk = Math.min(0.09, dur * 0.18);
      var rel = Math.min(0.12, dur * 0.25);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18 * ampMul, when + atk);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18 * ampMul, when + Math.max(dur - rel, atk + 0.02));
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, when + dur);

      osc.connect(g);
      nSrc.connect(nBP); nBP.connect(nG); nG.connect(g);
      g.connect(offline.destination);

      osc.start(when); vib.start(when); nSrc.start(when);
      osc.stop(when + dur); vib.stop(when + dur); nSrc.stop(when + dur);
    }

    function lead(when, note, beats) {
      flute(when, N[note], beats * beat * 0.95, 1.0, 0, 1.0);
    }
    function harm(when, note, beats) {
      flute(when, N[note], beats * beat * 0.95, 1.3, -2, 0.75);
    }

    // // --- DRONE: sustained low D + A fifth ---
    // function drone(when, dur) {

    //     { freq: 146.83, gain: 0.05 },   // D3 root
    //     { freq: 220.00, gain: 0.03 }    // A3 fifth (softer)

    //     osc.start(when); vib.start(when); nSrc.start(when);
    //     osc.stop(when + dur); vib.stop(when + dur); nSrc.stop(when + dur);

    // --- HAND DRUM (bodhrán-style) ---
    function drum(when, strength) {
      var thump = offline.createOscillator(); thump.type = 'sine';
      thump.frequency.setValueAtTime(90, when);
      thump.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(55, when + 0.12);
      var thumpG = offline.createGain();
      thumpG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.38 * strength, when);
      thumpG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + 0.15);
      thump.connect(thumpG); thumpG.connect(offline.destination);
      thump.start(when); thump.stop(when + 0.18);

      var body = offline.createOscillator(); body.type = 'sine';
      body.frequency.value = 180;
      var bodyG = offline.createGain();
      bodyG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.16 * strength, when);
      bodyG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + 0.1);
      body.connect(bodyG); bodyG.connect(offline.destination);
      body.start(when); body.stop(when + 0.12);

      var nLen = Math.ceil(sr * 0.04);
      var nBuf = offline.createBuffer(1, nLen, sr);
      var nd = nBuf.getChannelData(0);
      for (var i = 0; i < nLen; i++) nd[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      var nSrc = offline.createBufferSource(); nSrc.buffer = nBuf;
      var nBP = offline.createBiquadFilter();
      nBP.type = 'bandpass'; nBP.frequency.value = 2200; nBP.Q.value = 1.5;
      var nG = offline.createGain();
      nG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.13 * strength, when);
      nG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + 0.04);
      nSrc.connect(nBP); nBP.connect(nG); nG.connect(offline.destination);
      nSrc.start(when); nSrc.stop(when + 0.05);
    }

    // --- BASS FLUTE: octave-low wooden flute / alto recorder character ---
    function bassFlute(when, freq, dur) {
      var osc = offline.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine'; osc.frequency.value = freq;

      var oct = offline.createOscillator();
      oct.type = 'sine'; oct.frequency.value = freq * 2;
      var octG = offline.createGain(); octG.gain.value = 0.18;
      oct.connect(octG);

      var vib = offline.createOscillator();
      var vibG = offline.createGain();
      vib.frequency.value = 3.4 + Math.random() * 0.4;
      vibG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      vibG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when + Math.min(0.3, dur * 0.2));
      vibG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.006, when + Math.min(0.7, dur * 0.45));
      vib.connect(vibG);
      vibG.connect(osc.frequency); vibG.connect(oct.frequency);

      var nLen = Math.ceil(sr * dur);
      var nBuf = offline.createBuffer(1, nLen, sr);
      var nd = nBuf.getChannelData(0);
      for (var i = 0; i < nLen; i++) nd[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      var nSrc = offline.createBufferSource(); nSrc.buffer = nBuf;
      var nBP = offline.createBiquadFilter();
      nBP.type = 'bandpass';
      nBP.frequency.value = freq * 3.5;
      nBP.Q.value = 3.5;
      var nG = offline.createGain(); nG.gain.value = 0.10;

      var g = offline.createGain();
      var atk = Math.min(0.22, dur * 0.18);
      var rel = Math.min(0.30, dur * 0.25);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.11, when + atk);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.11, when + Math.max(dur - rel, atk + 0.02));
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, when + dur);

      osc.connect(g); octG.connect(g);
      nSrc.connect(nBP); nBP.connect(nG); nG.connect(g);
      g.connect(offline.destination);

      osc.start(when); oct.start(when); vib.start(when); nSrc.start(when);
      osc.stop(when + dur); oct.stop(when + dur);
      vib.stop(when + dur); nSrc.stop(when + dur);
    }

    function bass(when, note, beats) {
      bassFlute(when, N[note], beats * beat * 0.95);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  SCORE — 16 bars, A section (1-8) + B section (9-16)
    // ============================================================

    // ---- LEAD FLUTE ----
    var leadScore = [
      // === A SECTION ===
      [ 0,   'D5', 1.5], [ 1.5, 'F5', 0.5], [ 2,   'E5', 1], [ 3,   'D5', 1],
      [ 4,   'C5', 1.5], [ 5.5, 'D5', 0.5], [ 6,   'A4', 2],
      [ 8,   'D5', 1.5], [ 9.5, 'F5', 0.5], [10,   'E5', 1], [11,   'D5', 1],
      [12,   'Bb4', 1.5],[13.5, 'C5', 0.5], [14,   'D5', 2],
      [16,   'F5', 1],   [17,   'E5', 0.5], [17.5, 'D5', 0.5],
      [20,   'E5', 1],   [21,   'D5', 0.5], [21.5, 'C5', 0.5],
      [24,   'D5', 1],   [25,   'C5', 1],   [26,   'Bb4', 1], [27,   'A4', 1],
      [28,   'D5', 3.5],

      // === B SECTION (bars 9-16, stays in D minor, rising → peak → descent) ===
      // Bars 9-10: solo opening, inverted arc (rises from A4 up to F5)
      [32,   'A4', 1.5], [33.5, 'C5', 0.5], [34,   'D5', 1],  [35,   'F5', 1],
      [36,   'E5', 1.5], [37.5, 'D5', 0.5], [38,   'F5', 2],
      // Bars 11-12: harmony joins, gentle settling
      [40,   'E5', 1],   [41,   'D5', 1],   [42,   'C5', 1],  [43,   'D5', 1],
      [44,   'A4', 1.5], [45.5, 'Bb4', 0.5],[46,   'A4', 2],
      // Bars 13-14: climbs again toward the peak
      [48,   'D5', 1],   [49,   'E5', 1],   [50,   'F5', 1],  [51,   'E5', 1],
      [52,   'D5', 1.5], [53.5, 'C5', 0.5], [54,   'D5', 2],
      // Bars 15-16: descending resolution back to D5 for the loop
      [56,   'Bb4', 1],  [57,   'A4', 1],   [58,   'G4', 1],  [59,   'A4', 1],
      [60,   'D5', 3.5]
    ];

    // ---- HARMONY FLUTE ----
    var harmScore = [
      // === A SECTION ===
      [ 8,   'A4', 1.5], [ 9.5, 'D5', 0.5], [10,   'C5', 1],  [11,   'A4', 1],
      [12,   'G4', 1.5], [13.5, 'A4', 0.5], [14,   'A4', 2],
      [18,   'A4', 1],   [19,   'G4', 0.5], [19.5, 'A4', 0.5],
      [22,   'G4', 1],   [23,   'F4', 1],
      [24,   'A4', 1],   [25,   'G4', 1],   [26,   'F4', 1],  [27,   'E4', 1],
      [28,   'A4', 3.5],

      // === B SECTION (silent in bars 9-10 — lead states new theme alone) ===
      // Bars 11-12: 3rds/4ths below lead
      [40,   'C5', 1],   [41,   'A4', 1],   [42,   'A4', 1],  [43,   'A4', 1],
      [44,   'F4', 1.5], [45.5, 'G4', 0.5], [46,   'F4', 2],
      // Bars 13-14: parallel motion (3rds) supporting the climb
      [48,   'A4', 1],   [49,   'C5', 1],   [50,   'D5', 1],  [51,   'C5', 1],
      [52,   'A4', 1.5], [53.5, 'A4', 0.5], [54,   'A4', 2],
      // Bars 15-16: descending 3rds below the lead's descent
      [56,   'G4', 1],   [57,   'F4', 1],   [58,   'E4', 1],  [59,   'F4', 1],
      [60,   'A4', 3.5]
    ];

    // ---- Schedule lead & harmony ----
    for (var i = 0; i < leadScore.length; i++) {
      lead(leadScore[i][0] * beat, leadScore[i][1], leadScore[i][2]);
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < harmScore.length; j++) {
      harm(harmScore[j][0] * beat, harmScore[j][1], harmScore[j][2]);
    }

    // ---- Schedule drone (sustained whole loop) ----
    //drone(0, beat * 4 * bars);

   // Short bass-flute "shadows" under sustained lead notes — sparse, melodic.
    var bassScore = [
      // A section — 3 echoes under phrase endings
      [ 6,  'D4', 1.25],  // bar 2: under held A4 (a 4th below)
      [14,  'A3', 1.5],   // bar 4: under held D5 (a 4th below)
      [28,  'D4', 2],     // bar 8: under long D5 (octave below — closes A section)
      // B section — 3 echoes mirroring the A pattern
      [38,  'D4', 1.5],   // bar 10: under held F5 (3rd below)
      [54,  'A3', 1.5],   // bar 14: under held D5 (a 4th below)
      [60,  'D4', 2]      // bar 16: under final D5 (octave below — anchors the loop)
    ];

    for (var b = 0; b < bassScore.length; b++) {
      bass(bassScore[b][0] * beat, bassScore[b][1], bassScore[b][2]);
    }

    // ---- HAND DRUM ----
    var drumScore = [
      // A section
      [ 0, 1.0],
      [ 4, 1.0], [ 6, 0.45],
      [ 8, 1.0],
      [12, 1.0], [14, 0.45],
      [16, 0.65],
      [20, 0.65],
      [24, 1.0], [26, 0.45],
      [28, 1.0],
      // B section
      [32, 1.0],
      [36, 1.0], [38, 0.45],
      [40, 1.0],
      [44, 1.0], [46, 0.45],
      [48, 1.0], [50, 0.5], [51, 0.4],
      [52, 1.0], [54, 0.5], [55, 0.4],
      [56, 1.0], [58, 0.45],
      [60, 1.0], [63, 0.55]
    ];
    for (var k = 0; k < drumScore.length; k++) {
      drum(drumScore[k][0] * beat, drumScore[k][1]);
    }

    // ---- Render asynchronously, then loop seamlessly ----
    offline.startRendering().then(function(rendered) {
      if (!alive) return;
      srcNode = ctx.createBufferSource();
      srcNode.buffer = rendered;
      srcNode.loop = true;
      srcNode.loopStart = 0;
      srcNode.loopEnd = beat * 4 * bars; // 41.74s at 92 BPM
      srcNode.connect(masterG);
      srcNode.start();
    }).catch(function(err) {
      console.warn('Flute shanty render failed:', err);
    });

    return function() {
      alive = false;
      if (srcNode) { try { srcNode.stop(); } catch(e) {} }
    };
  }
});


registerSound({
  id: 'shanty_flute_2', icon: '&#x1F3B5;', name: 'Flute Shanty II',
  desc: 'Companion ritournelle — gentle wave melody, descending arc, ~45s loop',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var alive = true;
    var srcNode = null;
    var masterG = ctx.createGain();
    masterG.gain.value = 0.6;
    masterG.connect(ctx.destination);

    var tempo = 86;             // slightly slower — more lullaby than march
    var beat  = 60 / tempo;
    var bars  = 16;
    var totalDur = beat * 4 * bars + 0.6;
    var sr = ctx.sampleRate;

    var OAC = window.OfflineAudioContext || window.webkitOfflineAudioContext;
    var offline = new OAC(2, Math.ceil(sr * totalDur), sr);

    var N = {
      'A3': 220.00, 'Bb3': 233.08, 'C4': 261.63, 'D4': 293.66, 'E4': 329.63,
      'F4': 349.23, 'G4': 392.00, 'A4': 440.00, 'Bb4': 466.16,
      'C5': 523.25, 'D5': 587.33, 'E5': 659.25, 'F5': 698.46
    };

    // --- FLUTE (parameterizable for lead vs harmony) ---
    function flute(when, freq, dur, breathiness, detuneCents, ampMul) {
      var osc = offline.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = freq;
      osc.detune.value = detuneCents || 0;

      var vib = offline.createOscillator();
      var vibG = offline.createGain();
      vib.frequency.value = 4.8 + Math.random() * 0.5;
      vibG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      vibG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when + Math.min(0.12, dur * 0.25));
      vibG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.005, when + Math.min(0.32, dur * 0.55));
      vib.connect(vibG); vibG.connect(osc.frequency);

      var nLen = Math.ceil(sr * dur);
      var nBuf = offline.createBuffer(1, nLen, sr);
      var nd = nBuf.getChannelData(0);
      for (var i = 0; i < nLen; i++) nd[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      var nSrc = offline.createBufferSource(); nSrc.buffer = nBuf;
      var nBP = offline.createBiquadFilter();
      nBP.type = 'bandpass';
      nBP.frequency.value = freq * 2;
      nBP.Q.value = 5;
      var nG = offline.createGain();
      nG.gain.value = 0.05 * breathiness;

      var g = offline.createGain();
      var atk = Math.min(0.09, dur * 0.18);
      var rel = Math.min(0.12, dur * 0.25);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18 * ampMul, when + atk);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18 * ampMul, when + Math.max(dur - rel, atk + 0.02));
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, when + dur);

      osc.connect(g);
      nSrc.connect(nBP); nBP.connect(nG); nG.connect(g);
      g.connect(offline.destination);

      osc.start(when); vib.start(when); nSrc.start(when);
      osc.stop(when + dur); vib.stop(when + dur); nSrc.stop(when + dur);
    }

    function lead(when, note, beats) {
      flute(when, N[note], beats * beat * 0.95, 1.0, 0, 1.0);
    }
    function harm(when, note, beats) {
      flute(when, N[note], beats * beat * 0.95, 1.3, -2, 0.75);
    }

    // --- HAND DRUM (bodhrán-style) ---
    function drum(when, strength) {
      var thump = offline.createOscillator(); thump.type = 'sine';
      thump.frequency.setValueAtTime(90, when);
      thump.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(55, when + 0.12);
      var thumpG = offline.createGain();
      thumpG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.38 * strength, when);
      thumpG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + 0.15);
      thump.connect(thumpG); thumpG.connect(offline.destination);
      thump.start(when); thump.stop(when + 0.18);

      var body = offline.createOscillator(); body.type = 'sine';
      body.frequency.value = 180;
      var bodyG = offline.createGain();
      bodyG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.16 * strength, when);
      bodyG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + 0.1);
      body.connect(bodyG); bodyG.connect(offline.destination);
      body.start(when); body.stop(when + 0.12);

      var nLen = Math.ceil(sr * 0.04);
      var nBuf = offline.createBuffer(1, nLen, sr);
      var nd = nBuf.getChannelData(0);
      for (var i = 0; i < nLen; i++) nd[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      var nSrc = offline.createBufferSource(); nSrc.buffer = nBuf;
      var nBP = offline.createBiquadFilter();
      nBP.type = 'bandpass'; nBP.frequency.value = 2200; nBP.Q.value = 1.5;
      var nG = offline.createGain();
      nG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.13 * strength, when);

      nSrc.connect(nBP); nBP.connect(nG); nG.connect(offline.destination);
      nSrc.start(when); nSrc.stop(when + 0.05);
    }

    // --- BASS FLUTE (short shadow notes) ---
    function bassFlute(when, freq, dur) {

      osc.type = 'sine'; osc.frequency.value = freq;

      var oct = offline.createOscillator();
      oct.type = 'sine'; oct.frequency.value = freq * 2;

      nBP.type = 'bandpass';
