      // Bars 9-12 (harmony joins)
      [32, 1.0],
      [36, 0.9], [38, 0.45],
      [40, 1.0],
      [44, 0.9], [46, 0.45],
      // Bars 13-16 (descent)
      [48, 1.0], [50, 0.5],
      [52, 0.9], [54, 0.5],
      [56, 1.0], [58, 0.45],
      [60, 0.9], [62, 0.5], [63, 0.4]
    ];
    for (var k = 0; k < drumScore.length; k++) {
      drum(drumScore[k][0] * beat, drumScore[k][1]);
    }

    // ---- Render asynchronously, then loop seamlessly ----
    offline.startRendering().then(function(rendered) {
      if (!alive) return;
      srcNode = ctx.createBufferSource();
      srcNode.buffer = rendered;
      srcNode.loop = true;
      srcNode.loopStart = 0;
      srcNode.loopEnd = beat * 4 * bars; // ~44.65s at 86 BPM
      srcNode.connect(masterG);
      srcNode.start();
    }).catch(function(err) {
      console.warn('Flute Shanty II render failed:', err);
    });

    return function() {
      alive = false;
      if (srcNode) { try { srcNode.stop(); } catch(e) {} }
    };
  }
});



// -- Wind in the Rigging -----------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'wind', icon: '&#x1F4A8;', name: 'Wind in the Rigging',
  desc: 'Gusts whistling through ropes and sails',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 20); src.loop = true;

    var hpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); hpf.type = 'highpass'; hpf.frequency.value = 200;
    var lpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lpf.type = 'lowpass'; lpf.frequency.value = 1400; lpf.Q.value = 0.7;

    var lfo1 = ctx.createOscillator(); var lg1 = ctx.createGain();
    lfo1.frequency.value = 0.09; lg1.gain.value = 600;
    lfo1.connect(lg1); lg1.connect(lpf.frequency);

    var lfo2 = ctx.createOscillator(); var lg2 = ctx.createGain();
    lfo2.frequency.value = 0.27; lg2.gain.value = 250;
    lfo2.connect(lg2); lg2.connect(lpf.frequency);

    // Whistling resonant peak — rigging "singing" in gusts
    var whistle = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    whistle.type = 'bandpass'; whistle.frequency.value = 900; whistle.Q.value = 8;
    var wLfo = ctx.createOscillator(); var wLg = ctx.createGain();
    wLfo.frequency.value = 0.05; wLg.gain.value = 300;
    wLfo.connect(wLg); wLg.connect(whistle.frequency);
    var whistleG = ctx.createGain(); whistleG.gain.value = 0.25;

    var vLfo = ctx.createOscillator(); var vLg = ctx.createGain();
    vLfo.frequency.value = 0.14; vLg.gain.value = 0.1;
    vLfo.connect(vLg);

    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.32;
    vLg.connect(master.gain);

    src.connect(hpf); hpf.connect(lpf); lpf.connect(master);
    lpf.connect(whistle); whistle.connect(whistleG); whistleG.connect(master);
    master.connect(ctx.destination);

    src.start(); lfo1.start(); lfo2.start(); wLfo.start(); vLfo.start();

    return function() {
      try { src.stop();  } catch(e) {}
      try { lfo1.stop(); } catch(e) {}
      try { lfo2.stop(); } catch(e) {}
      try { wLfo.stop(); } catch(e) {}
      try { vLfo.stop(); } catch(e) {}
    };
  }
});

// -- Rain ----------------------------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'rain', icon: '&#x1F327;', name: 'Rain',
  desc: 'Steady rain pattering on deck and sails',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 15); src.loop = true;

    var hpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); hpf.type = 'highpass'; hpf.frequency.value = 1800;
    var lpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lpf.type = 'lowpass'; lpf.frequency.value = 7000;

    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.3;
    src.connect(hpf); hpf.connect(lpf); lpf.connect(master);
    master.connect(ctx.destination);
    src.start();

    // Sparse droplet "ticks" — random higher-pitched clicks
    var alive = true;
    var timers = [];
    function drop() {
      if (!alive) return;
      var when = ctx.currentTime + 0.01;
      var d = ctx.createBufferSource();
      d.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.012);
      var df = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      df.type = 'bandpass'; df.frequency.value = 3500 + Math.random() * 3500; df.Q.value = 3;
      var dg = ctx.createGain();
      dg.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06 + Math.random() * 0.05, when);
      dg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + 0.012);
      d.connect(df); df.connect(dg); dg.connect(master);
      d.start(when); d.stop(when + 0.015);
      timers.push(setTimeout(drop, 15 + Math.random() * 40));
    }
    drop();

    return function() {
      alive = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < timers.length; i++) clearTimeout(timers[i]);
      try { src.stop(); } catch(e) {}
    };
  }
});

// -- Distant Thunder ----------------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'thunder', icon: '&#x26A1;', name: 'Distant Thunder',
  desc: 'A storm rolling in over the horizon',
  loop: false, durationSec: 4,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.55;
    master.connect(ctx.destination);
    var t0 = ctx.currentTime;

    // Initial crack — already softened since it's far away, no sharp transient
    var crack = ctx.createBufferSource();
    crack.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 0.3);
    var crackF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    crackF.type = 'bandpass'; crackF.frequency.value = 500; crackF.Q.value = 1.5;
    var crackG = ctx.createGain();
    crackG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, t0);
    crackG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.3);
    crack.connect(crackF); crackF.connect(crackG); crackG.connect(master);
    crack.start(t0); crack.stop(t0 + 0.32);

    // Long rolling rumble — several overlapping low-passed bursts
    var numRolls = 8;
    for (var i = 0; i < numRolls; i++) {
      var when = t0 + 0.2 + i * 0.42 + Math.random() * 0.25;
      var dur = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5;
      var rumble = ctx.createBufferSource();
      rumble.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, dur);
      var rF = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      rF.type = 'lowpass'; rF.frequency.value = 120 - i * 6 + Math.random() * 20;
      var rG = ctx.createGain();
      var amp = 0.35 * (1 - i / (numRolls + 2));
      rG.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      rG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(amp, when + 0.15);
      rG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + dur);
      rumble.connect(rF); rF.connect(rG); rG.connect(master);
      rumble.start(when); rumble.stop(when + dur + 0.05);
    }
  }
});

registerSound({
  id: 'fire', icon: '&#x1F525;', name: 'Campfire Crackle',
  desc: 'A torch or campfire hissing and popping',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();

    master.connect(ctx.destination);
    src.start();

    var alive = true;
    var timers = [];

      if (!alive) return;

      var p = ctx.createBufferSource();
      p.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, dur);
      var pf = ctx.createBiquadFilter();

      pg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, when + dur);
      p.connect(pf); pf.connect(pg); pg.connect(master);
      p.start(when); p.stop(when + dur + 0.01);
      timers.push(setTimeout(pop, 80 + Math.random() * 350));
    }
    pop();

    return function() {
      alive = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < timers.length; i++) clearTimeout(timers[i]);
      try { src.stop(); } catch(e) {}
    };
  }

// -- Flapping Sail ---------------------------------------------
registerSound({
  id: 'sailflap', icon: '&#x26F5;', name: 'Flapping Sail',
  desc: 'Canvas snapping and ropes creaking in the wind',
  loop: true,
  synth: function(ctx) {
    var src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 12); src.loop = true;

    var bpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); bpf.type = 'bandpass'; bpf.frequency.value = 600; bpf.Q.value = 0.9;

    // Irregular amplitude modulation = canvas flapping rhythm
    var amLfo1 = ctx.createOscillator(); var amG1 = ctx.createGain();
    amLfo1.frequency.value = 0.6; amG1.gain.value = 0.5;
    amLfo1.connect(amG1);
    var amLfo2 = ctx.createOscillator(); var amG2 = ctx.createGain();
    amLfo2.frequency.value = 1.7; amG2.gain.value = 0.3;
    amLfo2.connect(amG2);

    var dynGain = ctx.createGain(); dynGain.gain.value = 0.18;
    amG1.connect(dynGain.gain); amG2.connect(dynGain.gain);

    var master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.3;
    src.connect(bpf); bpf.connect(dynGain); dynGain.connect(master);
    master.connect(ctx.destination);
    src.start(); amLfo1.start(); amLfo2.start();

    // Occasional rope creak — short pitched glide
    var alive = true;
    var timers = [];
    function creak() {
      if (!alive) return;
      var when = ctx.currentTime + 0.01;
      var f0 = 180 + Math.random() * 120;
      var dur = 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.25;
      var osc = ctx.createOscillator(); osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0 * 1.1, when);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f0 * 0.9, when + dur);
      var lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = 'lowpass'; lp.frequency.value = 500;
      var g = ctx.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, when);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.1, when + 0.04);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, when + dur);
      osc.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(master);
      osc.start(when); osc.stop(when + dur + 0.02);
      timers.push(setTimeout(creak, 2500 + Math.random() * 4000));
    }
    timers.push(setTimeout(creak, 1200));

    return function() {
      alive = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < timers.length; i++) clearTimeout(timers[i]);
      try { src.stop(); } catch(e) {}
      try { amLfo1.stop(); } catch(e) {}
      try { amLfo2.stop(); } catch(e) {}
    };
  }
});

// ============================================================
//  UI

function buildUI() {
  var grid = document.getElementById('soundGrid');
  if (!grid) return;
  grid.innerHTML = '';

  if (registry.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#b89a68;font-style:italic;grid-column:1/-1">No sounds registered.</p>';
    return;
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < registry.length; i++) {
    var s    = registry[i];
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'card';
    card.id = 'card-' + s.id;

    var typeLabel = s.loop ? 'loop' : 'one-shot';

    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'play-btn';
    btn.id = 'btn-' + s.id;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play ' + s.name);
    btn.innerHTML = '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="currentColor"><polygon points="5,2 16,9 5,16"/></svg>';
    btn.setAttribute('data-id', s.id);
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      toggle(this.getAttribute('data-id'));
    });

    var iconEl = document.createElement('div');
    iconEl.className = 'card-icon';
    iconEl.innerHTML = s.icon;

    var nameEl = document.createElement('div');
    nameEl.className = 'card-name';
    nameEl.textContent = s.name;

    var descEl = document.createElement('div');
    descEl.className = 'card-desc';
    descEl.textContent = s.desc;

    var typeEl = document.createElement('div');
    typeEl.className = 'card-type';
    typeEl.textContent = typeLabel;

    card.appendChild(iconEl);
    card.appendChild(nameEl);
    card.appendChild(descEl);
    card.appendChild(typeEl);
    card.appendChild(btn);

    grid.appendChild(card);
  }
}

function toggle(id) {
  var s    = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < registry.length; i++) {
    if (registry[i].id === id) { s = registry[i]; break; }
  }
  if (!s) return;

  var card   = document.getElementById('card-' + id);
  var btn    = document.getElementById('btn-' + id);
  var wasOn  = !!active[id];

  var playIcon = '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="currentColor"><polygon points="5,2 16,9 5,16"/></svg>';
  var stopIcon = '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><rect x="2" y="2" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/></svg>';

  if (active[id]) {
    try { if (active[id].stop) active[id].stop(); } catch(e) {}
    try { active[id].ctx.close(); } catch(e) {}
    delete active[id];
    card.classList.remove('playing');
    btn.classList.remove('playing');
    btn.innerHTML = playIcon;
  }

  if (s.loop && wasOn) return;

  var ctx;
  try {
    ctx = getCtx();
  } catch(e) {
    alert(e.message);
    return;
  }

  var stopFn;
  try {
    stopFn = s.synth(ctx);
  } catch(e) {
    var panel = document.getElementById('debug-panel');
    panel.style.display = 'block';
    panel.innerHTML = '<strong>Synth error in ' + id + ':</strong><br>' + e.message;
    try { ctx.close(); } catch(e2) {}
    return;
  }

  active[id] = { ctx: ctx, stop: stopFn };
  card.classList.add('playing');
  btn.classList.add('playing');
  btn.innerHTML = s.loop ? stopIcon : playIcon;

  if (!s.loop) {
    var ms = ((s.durationSec || 2) + 0.3) * 1000;
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (!active[id]) return;
      try { active[id].ctx.close(); } catch(e) {}
      delete active[id];
      card.classList.remove('playing');
      btn.classList.remove('playing');
      btn.innerHTML = playIcon;
    }, ms);
  }
}

// Run after DOM is ready
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', buildUI);
} else {
  buildUI();
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

function h2(t) { return `<h2>${t}</h2>`; }
function h3(t) { return `<h3>${t}</h3>`; }
function table(hd, rows) {
  let h = '<table><tr>' + hd.map(x => `<th>${x}</th>`).join('') + '</tr>';
  rows.forEach(r => { h += '<tr>' + r.map(c => `<td>${c}</td>`).join('') + '</tr>'; });

function pct(v) { return (v*100).toFixed(1)+'%'; }
function gold(v) { return typeof v==='number' ? v.toLocaleString()+'g' : v; }

function travelDaysBetween(from, to) {
  const p1=PORTS[from], p2=PORTS[to];
  if (!p1||!p2) return 999;
  const dx=p2.x-p1.x, dy=p2.y-p1.y;
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)/80));
}
function reachablePorts(homeKey, ship) {
  let count=0; const keys=[];
  for (const [k,p] of Object.entries(PORTS)) {
    if (k===homeKey) continue;
    const days=travelDaysBetween(homeKey,k);
    if (days<=ship.maxDays && (!p.minHull||ship.maxHull>=p.minHull)) { count++; keys.push(k); }
  }
  return {count,keys};
}

    const t=s.requiredFame>=200?3:s.requiredFame>=100?2:s.requiredFame>=50?1:0;
    const r=GOLD_RANGES[t]; if(!r) return;
    const trip=6;
    const il=Math.round((r.low[0]+r.low[1])/2/trip), im=Math.round((r.medium[0]+r.medium[1])/2/trip), ih=Math.round((r.high[0]+r.high[1])/2/trip);
    const v=il>dt?'\u2705':im>dt?'\u26a0\ufe0f Med+':'\u274c High only';
    rows.push([s.name,crew,gold(dw),gold(dp),`<b>${gold(dt)}</b>`,`T${t}`,gold(il),gold(im),gold(ih),`<span class="${v.startsWith('\u2705')?'good':v.startsWith('\u26a0')?'warn':'bad'}">${v}</span>`]);
  });
  html += table(hd,rows);
}

html += h2('\u2b50 Fame Gating');
{
  const hd=['Item','Type','Fame','Cost']; const rows=[];
  Object.entries(SHIPS).sort((a,b)=>a[1].requiredFame-b[1].requiredFame||a[1].cost-b[1].cost).forEach(([k,s])=>{rows.push([s.name,'Ship',s.requiredFame,gold(s.cost)]);});
  Object.entries(UPGRADES).sort((a,b)=>(a[1].requiredFame||0)-(b[1].requiredFame||0)).forEach(([k,u])=>{rows.push([u.name,'Upgrade',u.requiredFame||0,gold(u.cost)]);});

{
  let intercept = D.SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT_CHANCE || null;
  const margins = D.SMUGGLE_PROFIT_MARGINS;
  if (!intercept) {
    intercept = { low: 0.30, medium: 0.35, high: 0.40 };
    html += '<div class="warn">\u26a0 Intercept from fallback (0.30/0.35/0.40). Move to D.SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT_CHANCE for auto-read.</div>';
  } else {
    html += '<div class="good">\u2705 Reading intercept from D.SMUGGLE_INTERCEPT_CHANCE</div>';
  }
  const hd=['Risk','Intercept','Margin','T0 Cargo~','T0 Mission~','EV Clean','EV w/Flee','Net EV','Verdict']; const rows=[];
  ['low','medium','high'].forEach(risk=>{
    const ic=intercept[risk]||0.35, mg=margins[risk]||1.0;
    const t0=GOLD_RANGES[0][risk], am=Math.round((t0[0]+t0[1])/2), cc=100, profit=Math.round(cc*mg);
    const evC=profit+am;
    const evI=0.70*(profit+am)+0.20*(cc*0.5)-0.10*(cc+cc*0.5);
    const net=Math.round((1-ic)*evC+ic*evI);
    const v=net>0?'\u2705 Positive':'\u274c Negative';
    rows.push([risk,pct(ic),`${(mg*100).toFixed(0)}%`,`~${gold(cc)}`,`~${gold(am)}`,gold(evC),gold(Math.round(evI)),`<span class="${net>0?'good':'bad'}">${gold(net)}</span>`,`<span class="${net>0?'good':'bad'}">${v}</span>`]);
  });
  html += table(hd,rows);
}

{
  const events=D.RANDOM_EVENTS;
  const hd=['Event','Type','Choices','Best EV','Worst EV','Condition']; const rows=[];
  events.forEach(ev=>{
    let best=-Infinity, worst=Infinity;
    ev.choices.forEach(c=>{
      const o=c.outcome;
      let v=(o.gold||0)+(o.fame||0)*100-(o.hullDamage||0)*2-(o.crewLoss||0)*50-(o.daysLost||0)*10;
      if(o.moraleBonus) v+=o.moraleBonus*5; if(o.moralePenalty) v-=o.moralePenalty*5;
      if(v>best) best=v; if(v<worst) worst=v;
    });
    rows.push([ev.title,ev.type,ev.choices.length,`<span class="${best>=0?'good':'bad'}">${best===-Infinity?'?':Math.round(best)}</span>`,`<span class="${worst>=0?'good':'bad'}">${worst===Infinity?'?':Math.round(worst)}</span>`,ev.condition?'\u2705 Conditional':'Always']);
  });
  html += table(hd,rows);
  html += '<div class="dim">EV = gold + fame\u00d7100 \u2212 hullDmg\u00d72 \u2212 crewLoss\u00d750 \u2212 daysLost\u00d710 \u00b1 morale\u00d75</div>';
}
